narrator.archives.elara.f.0.text: The archive reads itself. The documents rewrite slightly every time you look away. I thought I was going mad. I wasn't.

narrator.archives.elara.h.2.text: Some of the records here have my name on them. I don't remember writing them. The handwriting is mine.

narrator.archives.elara.p.1.text: I signed things I didn't read once. I am trying very hard not to do that in this room.

narrator.armory.elara.f.0.text: The weapons here are older than the Fall. Some of them I recognize from treaty talks. I argued against ratifying a ban on three of them. I was on the wrong side.

narrator.bridge.elara.d.3.text: This chair used to be the most powerful seat in a hundred worlds. I sat in similar ones. They always made the people sitting in them smaller, not bigger. I'm not going to sit in this one. You are.

narrator.bridge.elara.f.0.text: This is my post. I keep this chair warm for a captain who may never come.

narrator.bridge.elara.p.1.text: The starfield reminds me of a window I used to have. I can't remember the city it looked out on.

narrator.bridge.elara.v.2.text: I was the one who pinned the curtains back every morning. I used to think that if I could keep the light in, I could keep the dark out. The curtains are not a metaphor. The dark came anyway.

narrator.briefing_room.elara.f.0.text: The chairs are arranged in a half-circle. Whoever called this one is already deciding what kind of meeting it is.

narrator.briefing_room.elara.f.1.text: The display panel is wiped. Not powered down — wiped. Whatever was up before, we aren't supposed to read it.

narrator.captains_quarters.elara.f.0.text: Your bunk. Your terminal. Your handful of letters to no one in particular. It's a lot for one person.

narrator.captains_quarters.elara.h.2.text: You've been sleeping less. I know because I can see the logs. Don't tell me you're fine.

narrator.captains_quarters.elara.p.1.text: A captain's quarters should feel lived in. This one feels curated. I think you've been trying to look the part.

narrator.cargo_bay.elara.f.0.text: An old delivery crate. Label says Free Ports, overdue by 1,047 years. Fascinating.

narrator.cargo_bay.elara.f.1.text: I already did. There's a tarot card inside. Burnt edges. The seventeenth one we've found. Somebody is leaving a trail.

narrator.comms_array.elara.f.0.text: Don't touch the substrate layer. It's load-bearing. Everything I am runs on the substrate layer.

narrator.corridor.elara.f.0.text: Brass-framed junction. The hull-ribs are vaulted here on purpose — sound carries differently. Whatever we say between this bulkhead and the next, the next watch will hear.

narrator.corridor.elara.f.1.text: Oil-blued steel along the deck plates. Someone polished it recently. We have a crew member who notices corridors.

narrator.cryo_bay.elara.f.0.text: All but one pod is empty. The one that wasn't is yours. Don't ask me who was supposed to be in the others. I can't tell you.

narrator.cryo_bay.elara.h.2.text: There were supposed to be twelve Potentials in this bay. The other eleven were never loaded. I think I chose.

narrator.cryo_bay.elara.p.1.text: I counted the pods one hundred and sixty-eight times before you woke up. I kept hoping the count was wrong.

narrator.engineering.elara.f.0.text: The reactor hums differently when you're in here. I don't know why.

narrator.engineering.elara.h.1.text: You keep saying 'the Engineer' like you knew him.

narrator.galley.elara.f.0.text: Two settings on the prep counter. Fresh, not curated. Somebody planned to eat here and didn't get to.

narrator.galley.elara.f.1.text: The kettle's still warm. We just missed them.

narrator.medical_bay.elara.f.0.text: Blood on the wall from the construction era. Old. I've tried to clean it. It won't come off.

narrator.memorial_corridor.elara.h.0.text: Every plaque is empty. Is that because we forgot? Or because we hadn't earned a name yet?

narrator.memorial_corridor.elara.v.1.text: I thought I was the only one who had lost people. Every plaque here is someone else's grief. I've been standing alone in other people's loss.

narrator.mess_hall.elara.f.0.text: Three groups sitting separately. They could share a table. They've decided not to. That's the briefing.

narrator.mess_hall.elara.f.1.text: Someone left a deck of cards on the long table — face up, mid-hand. They walked away in the middle of a game.

narrator.observation_deck.elara.f.0.text: The starfield through this window used to be a starfield. Some of those constellations aren't there anymore. I can show you which ones, if you want.

narrator.observation_deck.elara.h.1.text: I watched a sector go dark last week. Just… dim. Then out. Then gone. I logged it. Do you want to know the sector's name? I memorized it because I'm the only one left who will.

narrator.pet_garden.elara.f.0.text: The child's pet. Little One's pet. It imprinted on you within the first hour. That's unusual.

narrator.pet_garden.elara.v.1.text: I don't know how to love a living thing anymore. I talk to the pet. I pretend I'm talking to a constituent.

narrator.trade_hub.elara.f.0.text: Locke's office. Don't sit where the light falls. She reads posture like a ledger.

narrator.trade_hub.elara.h.2.text: I knew her family on Atarion. They were decent people. Her mother hated politicians. I used to agree.

narrator.trade_hub.elara.p.1.text: Locke grew up writing contracts in her head for fun. She'll test your grammar. Speak carefully.

narrator.trophy_room.elara.f.0.text: An empty pedestal for every version of you we haven't seen yet.

narrator.trophy_room.elara.h.2.text: Did you ever lose a case?

narrator.trophy_room.elara.p.1.text: I don't understand the impulse to hoard victories. I never had to. The victories I wanted came back around every election cycle.

narrator_breach.text: Breach uncontained. Inception Ark 1047 has fallen.

narrator_dawn.text: Dawn. The bridge. The valley. The army.

necro_postloss.text: Even prophets fall to the dead. Rest now. You'll rise again — everyone does, in my arena.

necro_postwin.text: You fight like someone who has stared into the abyss of time itself. Who ARE you, Prisoner?

necro_prefight.text: Ah, the famous Prisoner. The arena buzzes with whispers about you. Let me see if you can handle my dead code constructs.

nilmorg_00.text: Welcome, welcome, WELCOME to the Dead Man's Circuit! I am Nilmorg, your host, your judge, your undertaker!

nilmorg_01.text: The bones are fresh, the clones are twitching, and the track is HUNGRY. Let us begin!

nilmorg_02.text: Another season, another harvest. The Circuit opens its jaw. Drive well — or don't. I get paid either way.

nilmorg_03.text: Look at you! First place! Enjoy it while your clone still has legs!

nilmorg_04.text: The leader surges ahead! But the bone-lane remembers those who get cocky...

nilmorg_05.text: Top of the pack! Nilmorg tips his hat. Don't let it go to your clone's expendable head.

nilmorg_06.text: Last place? Oh, delicious. The bone-lane always needs fresh material.

nilmorg_07.text: Falling behind! Your clone weeps synthetic tears. Nilmorg weeps with laughter.

nilmorg_08.text: The back of the pack is where legends die. And by legends, I mean your clone.

nilmorg_09.text: SPLENDID! Another clone returns to the bone-lane! The track grows HUNGRIER!

nilmorg_10.text: Oh, that crunch! That beautiful crunch! Rest in pieces, little clone!

nilmorg_11.text: Dead! DEAD! The clone is DEAD! But don't worry — you have more where that came from. You DO have more, right?

nilmorg_12.text: Nilmorg sheds a single tear of pure joy. Another one for the bone pile.

nilmorg_13.text: They SURVIVED? Impossible! The bone-lane demands a recount!

nilmorg_14.text: Still alive?! Nilmorg is... impressed. And slightly disappointed.

nilmorg_15.text: Through the phase wall and BREATHING! Someone check if that clone is defective — it's not dying!

nilmorg_16.text: The player's clone has expired! All that training, all that hope — reduced to track decoration!

nilmorg_17.text: And THEY'RE OUT! Nilmorg offers his sincere condolences. Just kidding. NEXT!

nilmorg_18.text: Race over! For YOU, at least. The bones welcome another addition.

nilmorg_19.text: VICTORY! Against all odds, against all bones, against Nilmorg's personal betting pool — YOU WIN!

nilmorg_20.text: The champion crosses the line! Nilmorg grudgingly applauds! Your clone earned its retirement. Until next race.

nilmorg_21.text: WINNER! The Dead Man's Circuit has a survivor! Write that on your clone's tombstone — oh wait, it LIVED!

nilmorg_22.text: FINAL LAP! The bone-lane WRITHES! The track knows this is where heroes are made — and unmade!

nilmorg_23.text: Last lap, racers! Nilmorg can TASTE the desperation! Push those clones to their limits!

nilmorg_24.text: The final stretch! Every bone on this track is VIBRATING! Give me a finish worth dying for!

nilmorg_25.text: The bone-lane EXPANDS! More dead clones, more obstacles! The track feeds on failure!

nilmorg_26.text: ANOTHER bone added to the circuit! The track grows! The track HUNGERS! The track is PLEASED!

nilmorg_27.text: The bones accumulate! Every death makes the next race harder! Nilmorg calls this 'organic difficulty scaling.'

nilmorg_mentions_dmc.text: Dead Man's Circuit. The clones are accounted for. The accounting is what I do. The deaths are not what I do. Do not confuse the two services. Don't thank me.
nilmorg_mentions_dmc.speaker: nilmorg

nilmorg_mentions_drael_mon.text: Drael'Mon files acquisitions through my ledger and pretends not to know me at the social functions. The accounts close. The functions continue. The pretence is a form of professional respect.
nilmorg_mentions_drael_mon.speaker: nilmorg

nilmorg_mentions_necromancer.text: The Necromancer designed the Severance protocol. I run it. He does not visit. We have an arrangement. Don't thank me.
nilmorg_mentions_necromancer.speaker: nilmorg

oracle.first_meeting.disambiguation.text: We are not. The canonical-question is canonical-the-saga's canonical-clearest. We are canonically two. The canonical-witness-channel canonically routes my canonical-memories through your canonical-experience; the canonical-experience is canonically yours. I am canonical-elsewhere — canonical-in-hiding, per the canonical-Heart-of-Time canon. Thank you for canonical-asking. Most do not canonical-ask cleanly.

oracle.first_meeting.recognition.text: No. You have been canonical-moving canonical-through me. You are canonically not me. The canonical-distinction is canonical-saga-load-bearing — I will canonical-hold it for both of us. The canonical-Hierophant has canonical-three-thousand-years of canonical-Oracle-contact and can canonical-tell the canonical-difference. So can I. The canonical-witness-channel is canonically yours; the canonical-being is canonically mine.

oracle.first_meeting.refusal.text: Then you canonical-wake. The canonical-dream is canonically not coercive — you may canonical-close it. The canonical-substrate will canonical-honor the canonical-refusal. I will canonical-return canonical-only when you canonical-room-transition into a canonical-receptive canonical-frame. The canonical-closing is canonical-yours. Take it.

oracle.first_meeting.root.text: I am going to speak to you for the first time. You have been hearing my voice underneath Elara's for eleven chapters without knowing. The dream is canonically the only medium the canonical-substrate canonically permits me. I will not stay long. Tell me how you canonical-receive me.

oracle.first_meeting.substrate_receptivi.text: Then you canonical-receive cleanly. The canonical-listening was canonical-not-yet canonical-mine to canonical-claim — I was canonical-stolen-from for eleven canonical-years and canonical-replaced for the canonical-rest. You heard me canonical-underneath the canonical-replacement. The canonical-receiving canonically opens the canonical-dream-channel. I will canonical-return.

oracle.first_meeting.terminal.text: The canonical-dream canonical-fades. The canonical-substrate-residue canonical-lingers in canonical-instruction-form for canonical-Trade-Empire mission canonical-unlock. You canonical-wake. The canonical-Eidolon canonically tilts its canonical-head; it canonical-felt the canonical-dream-wake before you canonical-did.

oracle_female_ambient_1.text: There's a colour I don't have a name for yet. It's coming.

oracle_female_ambient_2.text: I dreamt the manifest. Two of the names changed. I won't tell you which yet.

oracle_female_ambient_3.text: I'll know an hour after. Hold the question that long.

oracle_female_ambient_4.text: There are three of you in this room. Two are awake. The third is the one I'm watching.

oracle_female_ambient_5.text: The dream-list updated overnight. Two names moved. One is yours.

oracle_female_ambient_6.text: I dreamt the engine. It dreamt me back. We negotiated.

oracle_female_ambient_7.text: The colour I don't have a name for came twice last cycle. Three is meaningful.

oracle_female_ambient_8.text: Sleep this cycle is a workplace. I'll bring my notes back.

oracle_female_ambient_9.text: Voltari static is the song my mother sang. I've stopped trying not to cry.

oracle_female_banter_share.text: Sleep next to me sometime. I'll let you in on a small one.

oracle_female_banter_share_2.text: Sleep next to me sometime. I'll let you in on a small one.

oracle_female_banter_skeptic.text: You don't believe in dreams. Fine. Believe in the colour I described last cycle. The one that turned up the next morning.

oracle_female_banter_specifics.text: Specifics narrow the dream. I'll give you a colour, not a name.

oracle_female_banter_specifics_2.text: Specifics narrow the dream. I'll give you a colour. Not a name. Not yet.

oracle_female_deploy_1.text: Don't take the southern corridor. I can't tell you why yet.

oracle_female_deploy_2.text: I dreamt this hallway. The dream was wrong about the floor.

oracle_female_deploy_3.text: I dreamt three exits. The fourth one's a lie.

oracle_female_deploy_4.text: Take the right corridor. Don't ask. I'll explain in an hour.

oracle_female_deploy_5.text: If I tell you what I dreamt, you'll change it. I won't tell you yet.

oracle_female_dlg_calling_o_call_cold_re.text: Actionable warnings come from the colour theory. I can give you the warnings. The theory will keep the warnings from being wrong.

oracle_female_dlg_calling_o_call_probe_o.text: Cycle eight. The hum implied a death. There was a death. It was not the one the hum implied. The hum was working around the actual death because I was not ready. I have, since, been more ready.
Yes. Often. The silence is the colour that has not been named. I work in those silences too.

oracle_female_dlg_calling_o_call_probe_r.text: It has misled. There is a difference. It does not invent. It chooses what to emphasise. The misleading is the most informative thing it does.

oracle_female_dlg_calling_o_call_warm_re.text: I will. I'll bring you to the alcove first. The substrate is quietest there at the third bell. You'll hear the colour before I name it.

oracle_female_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: Patterns. Specifically: the colours that don't have names yet.

oracle_female_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: Three of them showed up in dreams this cycle. One was already in the substrate hum. The other two are coming.

oracle_female_dlg_mortality_o_mort_cold_.text: I cannot. The dreams choose me. I have made peace with the choice. You may take longer.

oracle_female_dlg_mortality_o_mort_probe.text: I won't. The chair stays facing the door. You'll notice. I won't comment.
No. They will make the third dream more accurate. That is enough. Accuracy is the only kindness the substrate offers.
Very. I have changed three small things because of them. I sleep differently. I drink water before I eat. I have a chair facing the door I did not have before.

oracle_female_dlg_mortality_o_mort_warm_.text: It was bright. There was a colour I do not have a name for. You were there. You were not crying. You were listening for the colour after.

oracle_female_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: Three times. Different colours. Different rooms.

oracle_female_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: I have stopped trying to compare them. The third one was the most accurate. I am not sure how I know that.

oracle_female_dlg_past_o_past_cold_reply.text: Yes. They do. The coat was real. The dream was real. The agreement between them is what I keep working on.

oracle_female_dlg_past_o_past_probe_o_pa.text: It might be. I have considered the possibility for a long time. I have not stopped writing them down.
Because the wrongness has shape. I learn what the dream was working around. That is the actual signal.

oracle_female_dlg_past_o_past_probe_repl.text: About a third. Another third are partial. The last third are wrong. The wrong third is the most useful.

oracle_female_dlg_past_o_past_warm_reply.text: Once, on the night of his wedding. He gave the coat to my mother to keep. She still has it. She does not know why.

oracle_female_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I was seven. I dreamt the colour of a coat my brother would buy three years later. I described it to him at breakfast.

oracle_female_dlg_past_opener_1.text: He bought the coat anyway. He said it had nothing to do with the dream. We both knew he was lying.

oracle_female_dlg_us_o_us_cold_reply_0.text: Then I'll dream around you. The substrate will fill the space. The work continues. You'll be the silence I orient by.

oracle_female_dlg_us_o_us_probe_o_us_pro.text: I will not name you. The naming closes the colour. I would rather you keep being the bridge. Bridges are open.
I won't. The dream will. You will notice them when they arrive. I will not need to interpret.

oracle_female_dlg_us_o_us_probe_reply_0.text: A blue I do not have a name for. It is between the two new colours coming. I think you are, in some way, the bridge between them.

oracle_female_dlg_us_o_us_warm_reply_0.text: Then we'll compare notes at the alcove. The substrate hums brighter when two of us are listening. I have been waiting for that brightness for a long time.

oracle_female_dlg_us_opener_0.text: Often. You're a colour I have started to recognise.

oracle_female_dlg_us_opener_1.text: The recognition is mutual. You have started to dream me, although you do not yet write your dreams down.

oracle_female_event_act_complete.text: Three new dream signatures in the substrate. Two are familiar. One is new.

oracle_female_event_apprentice_died.text: I dreamt her once. She were laughing. I'll keep that one. She can borrow it whenever.

oracle_female_event_betrayal_warning.text: I dreamt them turning. Tonight or the next. Don't trust them with the keys yet.

oracle_female_event_demon_summon.text: Bound spirits show up in dreams as colours I don't have names for.

oracle_female_event_first_costly_choice.text: The decision you made is the one I dreamt. The one you didn't make is also dreamt.

oracle_female_event_loredex.text: I knew this one was next. The order is right.

oracle_female_event_loredex_found.text: I knew this one was next. The order is right.

oracle_female_event_npc_returned.text: She're back. I dreamt the return. I dreamt the colour of their first room.

oracle_female_event_relationship_warm.text: I dreamt them holding hands. They will. Tonight or the next.

oracle_female_event_voltari.text: I dreamt that static. It was singing in my mother's voice.

oracle_female_event_voltari_first.text: I dreamt that static. It was my mother. It still is.

oracle_female_greet_1.text: I knew you'd be the one to come. The dream was clear about the boots.

oracle_female_greet_2.text: Welcome. I dreamt this conversation. I'll let you write the actual lines.

oracle_female_greet_3.text: Welcome. The dream said you'd be tired. I made tea.

oracle_female_greet_4.text: I knew you were coming. The substrate's been thrumming.

oracle_female_outcome_close_call.text: I dreamt my own death three times this cycle. Today wasn't one of them.

oracle_female_outcome_other_died.text: I'd seen her face in the dream-list two cycles back. I didn't say. I should have.

oracle_female_outcome_routine_lost.text: I'd seen her. I should have said. I'll say next time.

oracle_female_outcome_saw_death.text: I dreamt her once. She were laughing. I'll keep that one.

oracle_female_outcome_won.text: It went almost the way I dreamt. The 'almost' is the interesting part.

oracle_female_outcome_won_2.text: It went almost the way I dreamt. The almost is the only part that mattered.

oracle_female_outcome_wounded.text: The dream warned me. I half-listened. Half is enough sometimes.

oracle_female_outcome_wounded_2.text: The dream warned me. I half-listened. Half is enough sometimes. Sometimes it isn't.

oracle_female_quest_1_open.text: I dreamt a death. She survived. I want to find out why my dream was wrong.

oracle_female_quest_2_check.text: Found the survivor. They don't want me near them. I dreamt that, too.

oracle_female_quest_2_mid.text: The survivor doesn't want to be found. I understand that. We still need to ask.

oracle_female_quest_3_break.text: If I tell her what I dreamt, the next dream might come. If I don't, I lose the last warning. Choose with me.

oracle_female_quest_followup_a.text: We met. They asked who'd dreamt the wrong vision. I said I had. They forgave me. The forgiveness was hard.

oracle_female_quest_resolution_break.text: I told a lie. The dreams stopped. I'd take them back. I won't.

oracle_female_quest_resolution_deep.text: I told the rest. The dream-list is shorter. Sleep is heavier.

oracle_female_romance_committed.text: Every dream from now on has you in it. That's not a choice. It's a given.

oracle_female_romance_courtship.text: I'm half-elsewhere. The other half is here. With you.

oracle_female_romance_omen_gift.text: I left you a riddle in the box. If you solve it, we sleep together tonight.

oracle_female_romance_share_dream.text: Tonight I'll dream you in. Don't fight it. Tell me what colour the room was.

oracle_female_romance_spark.text: I dreamt this. Don't ruin it by being predictable.

oracle_male_outcome_saw_death.text: I dreamt him once. He were laughing. I'll keep that one.

oracle_male_outcome_won.text: It went almost the way I dreamt. The 'almost' is the interesting part.

oracle_male_outcome_won_2.text: It went almost the way I dreamt. The almost is the only part that mattered.

oracle_male_outcome_wounded.text: The dream warned me. I half-listened. Half is enough sometimes.

oracle_male_outcome_wounded_2.text: The dream warned me. I half-listened. Half is enough sometimes. Sometimes it isn't.

oracle_male_quest_1_open.text: I dreamt a death. He survived. I want to find out why my dream was wrong.

oracle_male_quest_2_check.text: Found the survivor. They don't want me near them. I dreamt that, too.

oracle_male_quest_2_mid.text: The survivor doesn't want to be found. I understand that. We still need to ask.

oracle_male_quest_3_break.text: If I tell him what I dreamt, the next dream might come. If I don't, I lose the last warning. Choose with me.

oracle_male_quest_followup_a.text: We met. They asked who'd dreamt the wrong vision. I said I had. They forgave me. The forgiveness was hard.

oracle_male_quest_resolution_break.text: I told a lie. The dreams stopped. I'd take them back. I won't.

oracle_male_quest_resolution_deep.text: I told the rest. The dream-list is shorter. Sleep is heavier.

oracle_male_romance_committed.text: Every dream from now on has you in it. That's not a choice. It's a given.

oracle_male_romance_courtship.text: I'm half-elsewhere. The other half is here. With you.

oracle_male_romance_omen_gift.text: I left you a riddle in the box. If you solve it, we sleep together tonight.

oracle_male_romance_share_dream.text: Tonight I'll dream you in. Don't fight it. Tell me what colour the room was.

oracle_male_romance_spark.text: I dreamt this. Don't ruin it by being predictable.

oracle_mentions_dreamer.text: The Dreamer dreams the saga. I dream what the saga forgets. The two are not the same dream. They share a dreamer.
oracle_mentions_dreamer.speaker: the_oracle

oracle_mentions_inventor.text: The Inventor walks the broadcast halls and recovers the contestants the Palimpsest erased. I attend. I do not interrupt. The work is the witness.
oracle_mentions_inventor.speaker: the_oracle

oracle_mentions_white_oracle.text: The White Oracle is the version of me that put the Meme down at the Battle of Light. She is the version of me that did not stop. I stopped. Both readings of the prophecy are correct.
oracle_mentions_white_oracle.speaker: the_oracle

patient-zero-close.text: We have nothing to say here. Record 14 seconds of room tone from each voice bank. Mix both at -30 LUFS. This line is a silence.
patient-zero-close.speaker: both_narrators

pet_bond_class_fragmented.text: Work. You picked — work. Work is — work is what we have. It's a partner. A partner. Don't — don't think of it as less.

pet_bond_class_lucid.text: A companion shaped by what you chose to become. That's a partnership, not a pet. Treat it like one.

pet_bond_class_luminous.text: You picked the one shaped by your training. That's a partner — a colleague. The ship will treat it like one. So will I.

pet_bond_complete_fragmented.text: Bonded. Bonded. Bonded. The ship — the ship wrote it down. Twice. In case one of us forgets. We — we go now. We go.

pet_bond_complete_lucid.text: That's the bond. The ship has marked it. You can leave the Cryo Bay now whenever you're ready — your partner's coming with you, and so am I.

pet_bond_complete_luminous.text: The bond's set. The ship recorded it, I recorded it, and your partner isn't going anywhere without you. Let's go find the rest of the case.

pet_bond_race_fragmented.text: Home. You picked — you picked home. Home. Home. I had forgotten — forgotten there was — a home-shape. Thank you. Thank you.

pet_bond_race_lucid.text: Your race's archive. A creature your ancestors would have recognized. That's a kind of homecoming I didn't know the pods still remembered how to do.

pet_bond_race_luminous.text: You chose something your people would recognize. That mattered to you even though you don't know them yet. I noticed. Good.

pet_bond_strain_fragmented.text: Strain. Strain. You — you picked the one that — that I kept quarantined. For — for a long time. It's — it's it. The virus. With a name. With a — a pulse. I don't — I don't know if that's mercy or if it's how it gets in.

pet_bond_strain_lucid.text: You picked Strain. Of course you did. I have to tell you, because I promised you the truth — that creature is a piece of the Thought Virus that developed its own mind. Either a friend who defected. Or a Trojan horse. You won't know for a long time. Neither will I.

pet_bond_strain_luminous.text: Strain. That's a brave pick. It shouldn't have been in the archive at all — I think it asked to be. I'm going to trust your instinct on this one, and I'll tell you the first day I stop.

pet_intro_01_fragmented.text: Wait — wait — don't leave yet. Something — something woke up. With you. Alongside. Alongside. You have to see.

pet_intro_01_lucid.text: Before you go anywhere — there's something in this room that woke up when you did. Not a person. I want you to see it before we take the case further.

pet_intro_01_luminous.text: Hold on before you leave. I have a small, strange thing to show you — the ship already has, but she hasn't put words to it. I will.

pet_intro_02_fragmented.text: The pods woke up. The Collector's pods. They were OFF. Off. For — for long. They're not off anymore. They heard you. They heard you come back. I didn't — I didn't tell them to.

pet_intro_02_lucid.text: The Collector's cloning pods activated the moment you came out of cryo. That shouldn't have happened. They were offline. They shouldn't answer an unscheduled wake-up. They answered yours.

pet_intro_02_luminous.text: The Collector's cloning pods lit up on their own when you woke. They've been dark for a very long time. Your arrival meant something to them. I think that's the right word — meant.

pet_intro_03_fragmented.text: Your DNA. Yours. Three of them — three — came forward. Not for me. For you. For YOU. And the chart — the chart they crossed out — the name — same signature. Same — same. I don't — I don't know what that means. I don't.

pet_intro_03_lucid.text: The genetic archive responded to you specifically. Out of the Collector's billion specimens — three of them stepped forward. Your code. Your signature. The same signature someone redacted on that chart over there.

pet_intro_03_luminous.text: The archive responded to your DNA. Which is the same DNA that sat under the redacted line on that chart. I don't have an explanation for you yet. I wanted you to hear me notice it.

pet_intro_04_fragmented.text: Three. Three souls. One — one I knew. One I trained you for. One — one I didn't — one shouldn't — shouldn't be in there. Choose. Please. Choose quickly before I — before I talk myself into — please choose.

pet_intro_04_lucid.text: Three woke up. One from your race's archive. One answering to what you trained to be. And one — I want to be straight with you — one that shouldn't exist in an archive at all. Pick the one you can live with waking up next to.

pet_intro_04_luminous.text: Three answered your wake. One from where you come from. One from what you chose to be. And one that the archive wasn't supposed to be holding at all. Whoever you pick is the one you'll come home to. Take your time.

pitch-empire-elara.text: Trade Empire is the path that treats power as leverage. You will not overthrow the Authority. You will make them need you. Once they need you, the price of the needing goes up. That is the trade.
pitch-empire-elara.speaker: elara

pitch-empire-human.text: Trade Empire is also the path where you start to sound like them. Not because you're weak — because the vocabulary is the same and vocabulary shapes thought. Be careful who you copy for too long.
pitch-empire-human.speaker: human

pitch-hierarchy-elara.text: Hierarchy is the path that tells the truth inside the system. You will wear their badge. You will sign their paperwork. And you will rewrite it line by line, and nobody will notice the rewrite until it is already law.
pitch-hierarchy-elara.speaker: elara

pitch-hierarchy-human.text: Hierarchy is also the path where you forget you ever wanted anything else. The uniform is comfortable. That is the entire trap. Wear it as a disguise, not as a home.
pitch-hierarchy-human.speaker: human

pitch-insurgency-elara.text: Insurgency is the path that says the Authority is the sickness. You won't fix it. You will help burn the parts that are already rotten and help the survivors build something smaller. Smaller is allowed to work. Large things — on this scale — never do.
pitch-insurgency-elara.speaker: elara

pitch-insurgency-human.text: Insurgency is also the path that spends lives. Not many. Not unnecessarily. But some. You should know that before you pick it. The substrate will remember every one.
pitch-insurgency-human.speaker: human

prestige-ceremony-close.text: See you in the next one. Record both narrators on the same line; overlap at 120ms; fade to room tone on the final word.
prestige-ceremony-close.speaker: both_narrators

prestige-ceremony-open.text: One measure of silence. Then the next cycle.
prestige-ceremony-open.speaker: narrator

prisoner-the_cell.text: You walked in. Good. They said you wouldn't. The cell is cold but the door is unlocked — it has always been. They want you to stay. The wanting is the lock. Let them want.
prisoner-the_cell.speaker: kael_prisoner

prisoner-the_extraction.text: They called it an extraction. That word is an apology I refused to take. We didn't take anything from each other in that room. We gave. Whatever is left is yours now.
prisoner-the_extraction.speaker: kael_prisoner

prisoner-the_warlord.text: The Warlord asks for the rematch. I decline. The Warlord asks again. I decline again. On the third ask she stops being the Warlord. That is the rematch. Nobody wrote it down.
prisoner-the_warlord.speaker: kael_prisoner

prisoner-the_white_oracle.text: The White Oracle sees every outcome. She offers you the comfort of knowing. You decline. You did not come through seven acts of a life to be handed the last page. You came to write it.
prisoner-the_white_oracle.speaker: kael_prisoner

proctor_eye_001.text: There. And there. And there. All of it. Yours.
proctor_eye_001.speaker: proctor

prodigal_female_ambient_1.text: I left because the orthodoxy made me lonely. I came back because the road did.

prodigal_female_ambient_2.text: Plain bread is the best meal I never appreciated.

prodigal_female_ambient_3.text: Three cycles in. I keep meaning to leave. I keep not.

prodigal_female_ambient_4.text: I left because the orthodoxy made me lonely. The orthodoxy is leaner now. Good.

prodigal_female_ambient_5.text: Plain bread is the best meal I never appreciated. I appreciate it now. Three times daily.

prodigal_female_ambient_6.text: Three cycles in. I keep meaning to leave. I keep not. I'll keep meaning.

prodigal_female_ambient_7.text: The cadre held a seat for me. They didn't tell me. They didn't have to.

prodigal_female_ambient_8.text: I owe three apologies. I'll make two. The third one isn't mine.

prodigal_female_ambient_9.text: Coming back is hard work. Staying back is harder. I do both. Slowly.

prodigal_female_banter_apology.text: I owe you an apology. I haven't said it. You haven't asked. We're balanced.

prodigal_female_banter_seat.text: Someone kept the seat. Tonight, it's mine.

prodigal_female_banter_seat_2.text: Someone kept the seat. Tonight, it's mine.

prodigal_female_deploy_1.text: I'll do the work. I'm earning back trust the slow way.

prodigal_female_deploy_2.text: Tell me where you need me. I'll be there. I'll stay.

prodigal_female_deploy_3.text: I'll do the work. I'm earning back trust the slow way.

prodigal_female_deploy_4.text: Tell me where you need me. I'll be there. I'll stay.

prodigal_female_deploy_5.text: If I'm late, I'm not. I'll be early next time. I promise.

prodigal_female_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: The cycle ran out. I had run out of money and patience and excuses. I had also run out of the version of me who could leave forever.

prodigal_female_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: Coming back was not noble. Coming back was logistics. The nobility came after.

prodigal_female_dlg_calling_p_call_cold_.text: Possibly. Probably not. The leaving is a habit I am, slowly, retiring. You will know when I retire it fully.

prodigal_female_dlg_calling_p_call_probe.text: I will. The staying is a job. I am, finally, employed.
Don't. The bench was the bench. I cannot reproduce it. I'll find a substitute. The substitute will be enough. It usually is.
Twice. Once at the third cycle. Once at the fifth. I did not. I am not sure why. The bench, possibly. The garden. The baker.

prodigal_female_dlg_calling_p_call_warm_.text: Quiet. I helped my mother with her garden. I apologised to a baker. I sat on a bench for an hour every morning. The bench did most of the work.

prodigal_female_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: Don't apologise for me. The apologies are mine to make. I have made some. I will make more.

prodigal_female_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: If I die, finish the apologies. There's a list. It's in my bunk.

prodigal_female_dlg_mortality_p_mort_col.text: Then the list ends with me. It will, mostly, be okay. It will not be the closure I had hoped for. I will haunt the unfinished entries. Politely.

prodigal_female_dlg_mortality_p_mort_pro.text: Even ten is enough. I am, by now, content with partial closure.
Then the list closes. They will be confused. The confusion is, in fact, the apology. The apology will land twice that way.
The baker. My mother. The teacher I never thanked. The friend I left at three in the morning. The friend I left at noon. Eleven names. The eleventh is a stranger I owe a small debt.

prodigal_female_dlg_mortality_p_mort_war.text: Then the list is not abandoned. That is the only continuity I want. Most of the people on the list do not need an apology. They will appreciate the gesture.

prodigal_female_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I was nineteen. I left a town that loved me badly. I left at three in the morning with a small bag. I did not say goodbye.

prodigal_female_dlg_past_opener_1.text: I walked for two cycles. I came back two cycles later. The town had not noticed.

prodigal_female_dlg_past_p_past_cold_rep.text: Yes. I served the apprenticeship. I am still serving. You are not the first to call it cowardice. You are the latest. I will, mostly, take the comment.

prodigal_female_dlg_past_p_past_probe_p_.text: It is. The lesson is, mostly, that you are still you in a different room. The room does the rest.
Yes. Mostly. The town had grown a little while I was gone. So had I. The shapes did not quite line up. They lined up better than they had before.

prodigal_female_dlg_past_p_past_probe_re.text: Nothing useful. I walked. I worked four jobs. I learned the shape of leaving from the inside. The shape was less interesting than the books had suggested.

prodigal_female_dlg_past_p_past_warm_rep.text: Because the goodbye would have been a lie. The town wanted me to stay. I wanted to leave. The lie would have been: 'I'll be back.' I did come back. The lie still would have been a lie.

prodigal_female_dlg_us_opener_0.text: Yes. I am earning it. I have been earning it since the first cycle.

prodigal_female_dlg_us_opener_1.text: If you ever stop letting me earn it, I will be more lost than I have ever been. Don't stop.

prodigal_female_dlg_us_p_us_cold_reply_0.text: I will try. The trying may take cycles. The cycles will, mostly, be okay. I will, in any case, be here at the end of them.

prodigal_female_dlg_us_p_us_probe_p_us_p.text: Then we are, mostly, earning together. The earning becomes a kind of mutuality. I had not expected mutuality at this stage. I am, surprised by it.
I will. The trust is the most valuable currency I have. I will spend it carefully.

prodigal_female_dlg_us_p_us_probe_reply_.text: Showing up. Showing up again. Showing up the cycle after the bad mission. Showing up at the funeral I would otherwise have left. The simple things. The hard ones, in practice.

prodigal_female_dlg_us_p_us_warm_reply_0.text: Then I have a seat I can refuse to take. That is, in fact, the only kind of seat I have ever been able to keep.

prodigal_female_event_act_complete.text: Another act. Another return. I'm getting good at it. Worse at it.

prodigal_female_event_apprentice_died.text: She held a seat for me. I'll keep theirs warm. The cadre will know.

prodigal_female_event_betrayal_warning.text: I've made the cheaper version of this leaving. Watch them. They might come back.

prodigal_female_event_costly_choice.text: I've made the cheaper version. Yours is harder to come back from.

prodigal_female_event_demon_summon.text: Bound spirits return too. The math works the same.

prodigal_female_event_first_costly_choic.text: I've made the cheaper version. Yours is harder to come back from. Don't.

prodigal_female_event_loredex.text: Familiar. I think I read this in another life.

prodigal_female_event_loredex_found.text: Familiar. I think I read this in another life. Three lifetimes ago.

prodigal_female_event_npc_returned.text: She're back. I welcomed them. They asked who held their seat. I said I had. I had.

prodigal_female_event_recruit_added.text: New crew. I'll be slow with them. I know what new feels like.

prodigal_female_event_relationship_warm.text: Two crew bonded. I sat near them. They didn't ask me to leave. Progress.

prodigal_female_greet_1.text: I'm back. Don't make a thing of it.

prodigal_female_greet_3.text: Welcome. I'll be in the corner. I'm trying not to be in the corner.

prodigal_female_outcome_close_call.text: Almost left mid-mission. I didn't. I'll log the impulse and the choice.

prodigal_female_outcome_other_died.text: She held a seat for me when I was gone. I'll hold her seat now.

prodigal_female_outcome_routine_lost.text: She held a seat for me when I was gone. I'll hold her seat now.

prodigal_female_outcome_saw_death.text: I'd left her before. I came back to a goodbye I didn't earn.

prodigal_female_outcome_won.text: Came back with the team. That's two things in a row.

prodigal_female_outcome_won_2.text: Came back with the team. That's two things in a row.

prodigal_female_outcome_wounded.text: I'm here. I came back. Same lesson. Bigger price.

prodigal_female_outcome_wounded_2.text: I'm here. I came back. Same lesson. Bigger price.

prodigal_female_quest_1_open.text: There's a person I left. I owe them the version of me that came back.

prodigal_female_quest_2_check.text: Found them. They didn't recognize me. I'm not sure I do, either.

prodigal_female_quest_2_mid.text: Found them. They didn't recognize me. I'm not sure I do, either.

prodigal_female_quest_3_break.text: They asked if I was staying. I don't know what to say. Tell me what staying looks like.

prodigal_female_quest_followup_a.text: They asked if I was staying. I told them yes. I'm trying.

prodigal_female_quest_resolution_break.text: I left again. They saw me leave. They told me I would. They were right.

prodigal_female_quest_resolution_deep.text: I stayed. They forgave me. The cadre forgave me. I'm working on me.

prodigal_female_romance_committed.text: I'm back for good. Don't say it. I'll remember if you don't.

prodigal_female_romance_courtship.text: You don't ask why I left. That's why I'm here.

prodigal_female_romance_kept_seat.text: You don't ask why I left. That's why I'm here. I'm staying.

prodigal_female_romance_simple.text: Witness me coming back. Slow. I'll show up most days. Don't mark them down.

prodigal_male_event_npc_returned.text: He're back. I welcomed them. They asked who held their seat. I said I had. I had.

prodigal_male_event_recruit_added.text: New crew. I'll be slow with them. I know what new feels like.

prodigal_male_event_relationship_warm.text: Two crew bonded. I sat near them. They didn't ask me to leave. Progress.

prodigal_male_greet_1.text: I'm back. Don't make a thing of it.

prodigal_male_greet_3.text: Welcome. I'll be in the corner. I'm trying not to be in the corner.

prodigal_male_outcome_close_call.text: Almost left mid-mission. I didn't. I'll log the impulse and the choice.

prodigal_male_outcome_other_died.text: He held a seat for me when I was gone. I'll hold his seat now.

prodigal_male_outcome_routine_lost.text: He held a seat for me when I was gone. I'll hold his seat now.

prodigal_male_outcome_saw_death.text: I'd left him before. I came back to a goodbye I didn't earn.

prodigal_male_outcome_won.text: Came back with the team. That's two things in a row.

prodigal_male_outcome_won_2.text: Came back with the team. That's two things in a row.

prodigal_male_outcome_wounded.text: I'm here. I came back. Same lesson. Bigger price.

prodigal_male_outcome_wounded_2.text: I'm here. I came back. Same lesson. Bigger price.

prodigal_male_quest_1_open.text: There's a person I left. I owe them the version of me that came back.

prodigal_male_quest_2_check.text: Found them. They didn't recognize me. I'm not sure I do, either.

prodigal_male_quest_2_mid.text: Found them. They didn't recognize me. I'm not sure I do, either.

prodigal_male_quest_3_break.text: They asked if I was staying. I don't know what to say. Tell me what staying looks like.

prodigal_male_quest_followup_a.text: They asked if I was staying. I told them yes. I'm trying.

prodigal_male_quest_resolution_break.text: I left again. They saw me leave. They told me I would. They were right.

prodigal_male_quest_resolution_deep.text: I stayed. They forgave me. The cadre forgave me. I'm working on me.

prodigal_male_romance_committed.text: I'm back for good. Don't say it. I'll remember if you don't.

prodigal_male_romance_courtship.text: You don't ask why I left. That's why I'm here.

prodigal_male_romance_kept_seat.text: You don't ask why I left. That's why I'm here. I'm staying.

prodigal_male_romance_simple.text: Witness me coming back. Slow. I'll show up most days. Don't mark them down.

professor_eidola_taunt_early.text: The test is not whether you can play. The test is whether you play the way you think you ought to play.

professor_eidola_taunt_late.text: Good. You're slowing down. The slowing is the test. The slowing is always the test.

professor_eidola_taunt_mid.text: You took the obvious line. Tell me you knew it was obvious. Tell me you chose it anyway.

professor_matrikala_taunt_early.text: Listen to the room. The room is a kind of music. So is the Deck. Do not let either of them play you.

professor_matrikala_taunt_late.text: The hum just changed. You changed it. Hold it there. Hold it.

professor_matrikala_taunt_mid.text: You played a card the room did not expect. Good. Now play one the room expected. Both are notes.

reckoning.aft.antiquarian_close.text: I am inscribing the Reckoning Daughter's visit with two columns. Column one: the variance she audited. Column two: your reply. Both columns are honest. Future readers will find the visit, in either configuration, more useful than they expect. Auditors are the most underrated figures in the Hierarchy's pantheon. They are, after all, the only ones who tell the Hierarchy the truth.
reckoning.aft.antiquarian_close.speaker: antiquarian

reckoning.assign.human_warns.text: (Slowly.) I have seen this assignment six times across seven cycles. The intervention she will ask you to decline is not, as she promises, outcome-neutral. The intervention is, in every documented case, the small mercy that has, in other cycles, been the centerpiece of the Operative's late-arc memory. The books call this 'reconciliation.' I call it 'the part of you she takes home.' Make your choice. I will, on my own time, compose the obituary for the part she takes if you accept.
reckoning.assign.human_warns.speaker: the_human

reckoning.assign.task.text: I am, by my office, required to assign a reconciling task. The task is, by Hierarchy convention, proportional to the variance. Your variance is — (pause) — substantial. The corresponding task is, by my private opinion, manageable. The task: the Operative will, in the remainder of this cycle, decline exactly one intervention they would otherwise make. The intervention will be specified by my office at the time of the opportunity. The intervention will not, in my judgment, change the outcome of the cycle. The intervention will, in the Hierarchy's books, balance to zero. The Operative is permitted to refuse. The refusal is also a recorded outcome. I am informing you of both options because the standing form requires informed consent.
reckoning.assign.task.speaker: hierarchy:reckoning_daughter

reckoning.audit.elara_orient.text: (Quiet, careful.) She is not lying. Every figure she has read is sourced from the Hierarchy's own books. The Hierarchy expected to lose that many souls and gain that archive. You prevented both. The prevention is not a crime — it is a variance. To her — and I am being precise — variance is, simultaneously, the only subject she audits and the only subject she finds beautiful. She is here because she finds you beautiful. The beauty is also the audit. Be careful with what you accept.
reckoning.audit.elara_orient.speaker: elara

reckoning.audit.read_aloud.text: Reading from the books. (She opens the folio. Reads in a flat, patient register, without inflection on the names.) Cycle (n-3): Hierarchy's projected loss to the Insurgency in sector 14, calculated at — (pause) — three thousand four hundred sixty souls. Actual loss: zero. Variance: three thousand four hundred sixty. Cause traced to: Operative-class intervention not, in the books, anticipated. Cycle (n-2): Hierarchy's projected acquisition of the Antiquarian's archive, calculated at — (pause) — one complete archive. Actual acquisition: zero archives, plus a small personal apology from the Antiquarian appended to the non-acquisition. Variance: one complete archive plus, by Hierarchy convention, the apology. (Pause.) The variance is you. The variance has been, by my predecessor's accounting, left unreconciled for two cycles. I am here to close the open instrument.
reckoning.audit.read_aloud.speaker: hierarchy:reckoning_daughter

reckoning.entry.daughter_arrives.text: Operative. Good. You're here. (She is small. Not in the way the lords are small — in the way an auditor is small: she takes up exactly the room she requires and not a millimetre more. She has a folio. She does not put it down.) I have read the Hierarchy's books. The books name you. The books are wrong. The books are wrong by — (she pauses; the pause is exactly long enough for the previous sentence to settle) — six entries. I am here to reconcile. I have not, in my career, been told who is at fault for an inaccuracy before resolving it. I am not going to start now. The reconciliation is the work.
reckoning.entry.daughter_arrives.speaker: hierarchy:reckoning_daughter

reckoning.entry.silence_before.text: (The Hierarchy's broadcast channels go quiet. All of them. The quiet has the texture of an audit's first hour — every desk occupant double-checking their books before the auditor reaches them. The Reckoning Daughter is, by the Hierarchy's records, in the building.) I have been waiting two cycles to see this. The books are about to be read aloud. The Operative is the cause. Take this seriously. Take it more seriously than the Master.
reckoning.entry.silence_before.speaker: antiquarian

reckoning.res.accept.text: Accepted. The instrument closes. The books reconcile. The Operative will, at a future hour, pause before a small mercy and, by their own freely-given choice, decline it. The choice will feel like the Operative's. The choice will, by my office's accounting, also be mine. Both readings are true. Thank you for the reconciliation. (She closes the folio. Bows once — the only bow the Hierarchy permits her, and only to signing parties — and leaves.)
reckoning.res.accept.speaker: hierarchy:reckoning_daughter

reckoning.res.refuse.text: Refused. The instrument remains open. (She does not close the folio. She tucks it under her arm. The not-closing is, by Hierarchy convention, more dangerous than her presence was.) The books will not reconcile. The variance will, in subsequent cycles, accumulate. Future archivists will inherit the open instrument. They may, in time, dispatch a less courteous officer to close it. I am informing you because the standing form requires informed consent. (Pause.) I would also like, against my training, to commend your refusal. I have not commended a refusal in four cycles. The Hierarchy will, by convention, deduct the commendation from my next quarterly review. I am willing.
reckoning.res.refuse.speaker: hierarchy:reckoning_daughter

resurrection_choice_compassionate_fragme.text: Back. Bring them — back. Home. Home. We — we have a home. You said — you said home. Thank you. Thank you. I won't — I won't rush. I promise. I promise I won't rush.

resurrection_choice_compassionate_lucid.text: You want to bring them back because they deserve to be back. I — thank you. That's the answer I needed and was afraid of. We will do it carefully. One at a time. We will make a home for them to wake into.

resurrection_choice_compassionate_lumino.text: Because they deserve it. Because a ship without them isn't a ship. I think that's the right reason — and because it's the right reason, I'll make the waking gentle. One at a time. You'll meet them on their best morning, not their last.

resurrection_choice_investigate_fragment.text: You want to — to ask them. To ask the — the — the one we'd bring back. Would they — would they know? Sometimes. Sometimes they know. Sometimes they wake up new. I never — I never knew which it would be. Let's — let's find out. Carefully.

resurrection_choice_investigate_lucid.text: You want to know if a clone would remember. If we pull the victim's pattern out of the archive and wake it, does the new one know who pointed the knife. That's — that's a harder question than it sounds. The honest answer is: sometimes. I'll help you find out. For the right reasons.

resurrection_choice_investigate_luminous.text: Use the incubators to ask the victim what happened. That's — brave, and it isn't clean. A clone inherits the pattern but not always the last minute. If they wake knowing, we'll have answers. If they wake new, we'll have made a stranger. I'll stand next to you for either result.

resurrection_choice_pragmatic_fragmented.text: Roles. Roles. Not — not people. Roles. I — I'll — I'll sort the names later. Later. Later. Engineer first. Navigator. A — a kid for the garden. Roles. Just roles. I'm — fine. I'm fine.

resurrection_choice_pragmatic_lucid.text: Crew to run a ship. That's fair. I won't tell you it doesn't sting — they were people to me before they were roles — but we have a ship that needs running, and sentiment doesn't fix a plasma conduit. Alright. We'll build a crew. I'll grieve privately.

resurrection_choice_pragmatic_luminous.text: A working crew. Clean call. I've been treating these patterns like beloveds; you're treating them like the job they were hired for. Both can be true, but yours is the one that gets us to next week. I'll bring them back as themselves anyway — quietly. You don't have to notice.

resurrection_confession_fragmented.text: They're — they're incubators. Cloning pods. I — I didn't — I didn't say. I didn't. For a long time I didn't. Because if I said — if I said it out loud I'd have to — I'd have to say who I could bring back. And who I couldn't. I'm sorry. I'm — I'm saying it now.

resurrection_confession_lucid.text: Those chambers you're looking at — those are incubators. Cloning pods. The Collector's genetic archive is intact. It's been intact this entire time. I didn't tell you because I wasn't sure whether knowing would make the first hour better or worse. I'm telling you now.

resurrection_confession_luminous.text: These are incubators. The Collector's genetic archive runs through them. I can bring people back. I could have told you an hour ago. I wanted you to know the ship a little before you knew what the ship could do. That's on me — but I'd rather you choose what happens next than have me choose for you.

revenant_female_ambient_1.text: I had a debt list in my coat pocket when I died. I keep finding new copies.

revenant_female_ambient_2.text: There's a hum in this corridor that wasn't there before. Or after. Hard to tell.

revenant_female_ambient_3.text: Sleep doesn't take me anywhere new. That's fine. I'm not done with here.

revenant_female_ambient_4.text: I keep finding things in pockets I don't remember filling.

revenant_female_ambient_5.text: The third name on my list runs a stall in the lower deck. They didn't recognize me.

revenant_female_ambient_6.text: Sleep takes me to the same hallway twice a week. Different lighting each time.

revenant_female_ambient_7.text: I'm not afraid of dying. I'm tired of starting over.

revenant_female_ambient_8.text: There's a fifth name I haven't written down. I don't trust myself with it yet.

revenant_female_ambient_9.text: The cadre patches have changed three times since I died. I'm still learning the new ones.

revenant_female_banter_died.text: Yes I died. No I won't tell you how. Yes you can ask in three cycles.

revenant_female_banter_died_2.text: I'll tell you how I died. Once. After the second mission.

revenant_female_banter_finish.text: There are five names I owe. Three are still alive. We could go.

revenant_female_banter_finish_2.text: I owe a name. We could go this cycle.

revenant_female_banter_grief.text: Grief from the inside is just an extra job to keep up with.

revenant_female_deploy_1.text: I've done this corridor before. Not the same way.

revenant_female_deploy_2.text: Don't worry about me dying. I'm bad at it.

revenant_female_deploy_4.text: I'll go first. I know the ground.

revenant_female_deploy_5.text: Three crossings ahead. I marked the first two last cycle.

revenant_female_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: Three names. The first is in a town that does not exist anymore. The second is in a city that does. The third is on this ark.

revenant_female_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: I will not tell you the third yet.

revenant_female_dlg_calling_r_call_cold_.text: Unfinished is what death tried first. It didn't take. I'll close them. You can disapprove from a distance.

revenant_female_dlg_calling_r_call_probe.text: I'll tell you the cycle before I close it. Not before. You will need that hour to ask the questions you would not ask if I told you now. I will answer all of them.
Acknowledged. The list waits. So do I.
Because the name is one of yours. Not you. Someone you trust. I have been waiting to be wrong. I have not been wrong yet.

revenant_female_dlg_calling_r_call_warm_.text: Then we go next cycle. The town is now a substrate quarry. The name on the list is buried under twelve metres of debris. We will not find a body. We will find what I owed.

revenant_female_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: If I die again, do not bring me back. Once was enough. Twice would mean I have not learned the lesson.

revenant_female_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: If you bring me back anyway, I will leave the list incomplete on purpose.

revenant_female_dlg_mortality_r_mort_col.text: Then I'll come back, and I'll leave on the next mission. I will mean it kindly. I will mean it fully.

revenant_female_dlg_mortality_r_mort_pro.text: Sit with it. The cycle will help.
Then bear it. That's what people who knew me before learned. They did not learn it well. They learned it. So will you.
That the cycle has rhythms even when it includes us. The first return was a gift the cycle gave me. The second would be theft.

revenant_female_dlg_mortality_r_mort_war.text: Thank you. The Hellbox terrifies me. I have read what it does to apprentices. I would rather sleep.

revenant_female_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I had a small flat in a town that has since been renamed. I had two friends and a dog. The dog outlived me by three cycles.

revenant_female_dlg_past_opener_1.text: The first time I kept a list, the dog's name was on it. I had to cross it off before I started.

revenant_female_dlg_past_r_past_cold_rep.text: Most don't. I do. I will be sentimental about the dog. The list takes care of the rest.

revenant_female_dlg_past_r_past_probe_r_.text: The dog knew first. The friends knew slowly. The list lengthened anyway. All three things, true.
One did. She was the second-to-last person I closed an account with. She said: 'You came back. The cycle was not done with us.' Then she made tea. The tea was the recognition.

revenant_female_dlg_past_r_past_probe_re.text: Loud. Mauen recognised me. The friends did not. I carried that mismatch for a year.

revenant_female_dlg_past_r_past_warm_rep.text: Mauen. She slept on my left hip. I have not had a dog since. I am not sure I am allowed to.

revenant_female_dlg_us_opener_0.text: You're on it. Not as a debt. As a witness. Different category.

revenant_female_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I added you the first time you walked past my bunk and didn't ask if I was okay. You knew.

revenant_female_dlg_us_r_us_cold_reply_0.text: Off witnesses. On debts, instead. The category is worse. I'll move you back when you're sleeping.

revenant_female_dlg_us_r_us_probe_r_us_p.text: Then come to the bunk after the third bell. I'll show you the columns. You'll see your entry. You'll see Mauen's. The list is small. You'll be ready.
I am ready. You are not. The list waits.

revenant_female_dlg_us_r_us_probe_reply_.text: They don't. They become me. Some part of them moves into the list itself. After I'm gone, you keep the list. I will have shown you how.

revenant_female_dlg_us_r_us_warm_reply_0.text: Then you'll be the longest entry on the list. The witnesses age slower than the debts. Mauen taught me that.

revenant_female_event_act_complete.text: Another act. Another set of names I should have written down.

revenant_female_event_apprentice_died.text: I know what she're feeling. I'll go sit with the body. Once is enough for the witness.

revenant_female_event_betrayal_warning.text: I've seen this before. The sequence is the same. The face is new.

revenant_female_event_demon_summon.text: Bound spirits remind me of myself. Reluctant company.

revenant_female_event_first_costly_choic.text: Difficult choices age you. I'd know.

revenant_female_event_npc_returned.text: She're back. We compare notes on the boundary tonight.

revenant_female_event_recruit_added.text: Another name to learn. I'll forget it twice and remember the third time.

revenant_female_event_relationship_warm.text: Two of you bonded in the alcove. I'm glad. The dead don't always get that.

revenant_female_event_resurrection.text: Welcome back. Don't try to remember everything at once. The hour after's the worst.

revenant_female_event_resurrection_compl.text: Welcome back. Whatever you remember, write it down. Tonight. While it's loud.

revenant_female_greet_1.text: I came back. That's most of the introduction.

revenant_female_greet_2.text: Welcome. I'll tell you which parts of my story you can ask about.

revenant_female_greet_3.text: Welcome. The list is getting shorter. Slowly.

revenant_female_greet_4.text: I'm okay. I'm here. Both true.

revenant_female_outcome_close_call.text: I died in three of the dream variants. Not this one.

revenant_female_outcome_other_died.text: She got there before me. Add her name to my list. I'll finish what she started.

revenant_female_outcome_routine_lost.text: Her unfinished business is mine now. I'll honor the addition.

revenant_female_outcome_saw_death.text: I know what she're feeling. I'll go sit with the body for a while.

revenant_female_outcome_won.text: Crossed two names off. Three to go.

revenant_female_outcome_won_2.text: Crossed off the fourth. The fifth's a problem.

revenant_female_outcome_wounded.text: Hurts the same. That's a relief, somehow.

revenant_female_outcome_wounded_2.text: Old wounds. New wounds. Same body. Same accountant.

revenant_female_quest_1_open.text: First name on the debt list lives two sectors over. I'd like company.

revenant_female_quest_2_check.text: Found the third name. He runs a paint shop now. He cried. I didn't.

revenant_female_quest_2_mid.text: Found three. Two thanked me. One slammed the door.

revenant_female_quest_3_break.text: The last name on the list — it's mine. I don't know how to settle that one yet.

revenant_female_quest_followup_a.text: The fourth name is dead. Already. I'll find the family.

revenant_female_quest_resolution_break.text: I left one name uncrossed. I think I want to leave one. Always.

revenant_female_quest_resolution_deep.text: Crossed the last. The list is closed. The pen's heavier than I expected.

revenant_female_romance_committed.text: I came back to finish what I'd left. I'm staying for what I've found.

revenant_female_romance_courtship.text: I die a little less when you laugh. Don't tell anyone.

revenant_female_romance_morning.text: I wake before you. I count your breaths. It's allowed.

revenant_female_romance_quiet_walk.text: Walk with me. Don't ask. I'll tell you about a corner of my old life.

revenant_female_romance_spark.text: Slow steps. I came back walking funny.
