revenant_male_dlg_us_r_us_warm_reply_0.text: Then you'll be the longest entry on the list. The witnesses age slower than the debts. Mauen taught me that.

revenant_male_event_act_complete.text: Another act. Another set of names I should have written down.

revenant_male_event_apprentice_died.text: I know what he're feeling. I'll go sit with the body. Once is enough for the witness.

revenant_male_event_betrayal_warning.text: I've seen this before. The sequence is the same. The face is new.

revenant_male_event_demon_summon.text: Bound spirits remind me of myself. Reluctant company.

revenant_male_event_first_costly_choice.text: Difficult choices age you. I'd know.

revenant_male_event_npc_returned.text: He're back. We compare notes on the boundary tonight.

revenant_male_event_recruit_added.text: Another name to learn. I'll forget it twice and remember the third time.

revenant_male_event_relationship_warm.text: Two of you bonded in the alcove. I'm glad. The dead don't always get that.

revenant_male_event_resurrection.text: Welcome back. Don't try to remember everything at once. The hour after's the worst.

revenant_male_event_resurrection_complet.text: Welcome back. Whatever you remember, write it down. Tonight. While it's loud.

revenant_male_greet_1.text: I came back. That's most of the introduction.

revenant_male_greet_2.text: Welcome. I'll tell you which parts of my story you can ask about.

revenant_male_greet_3.text: Welcome. The list is getting shorter. Slowly.

revenant_male_greet_4.text: I'm okay. I'm here. Both true.

revenant_male_outcome_close_call.text: I died in three of the dream variants. Not this one.

revenant_male_outcome_other_died.text: He got there before me. Add his name to my list. I'll finish what he started.

revenant_male_outcome_routine_lost.text: His unfinished business is mine now. I'll honor the addition.

revenant_male_outcome_saw_death.text: I know what he're feeling. I'll go sit with the body for a while.

revenant_male_outcome_won.text: Crossed two names off. Three to go.

revenant_male_outcome_won_2.text: Crossed off the fourth. The fifth's a problem.

revenant_male_outcome_wounded.text: Hurts the same. That's a relief, somehow.

revenant_male_outcome_wounded_2.text: Old wounds. New wounds. Same body. Same accountant.

revenant_male_quest_1_open.text: First name on the debt list lives two sectors over. I'd like company.

revenant_male_quest_2_check.text: Found the third name. He runs a paint shop now. He cried. I didn't.

revenant_male_quest_2_mid.text: Found three. Two thanked me. One slammed the door.

revenant_male_quest_3_break.text: The last name on the list — it's mine. I don't know how to settle that one yet.

revenant_male_quest_followup_a.text: The fourth name is dead. Already. I'll find the family.

revenant_male_quest_resolution_break.text: I left one name uncrossed. I think I want to leave one. Always.

revenant_male_quest_resolution_deep.text: Crossed the last. The list is closed. The pen's heavier than I expected.

revenant_male_romance_committed.text: I came back to finish what I'd left. I'm staying for what I've found.

revenant_male_romance_courtship.text: I die a little less when you laugh. Don't tell anyone.

revenant_male_romance_morning.text: I wake before you. I count your breaths. It's allowed.

revenant_male_romance_quiet_walk.text: Walk with me. Don't ask. I'll tell you about a corner of my old life.

revenant_male_romance_spark.text: Slow steps. I came back walking funny.

right-gm-first-contact.text: I read from your right hemisphere. That is the pretty one. I am not fair. I am, however, extremely entertaining. Sit.
right-gm-first-contact.speaker: game_master_right

right-gm-first-defeat.text: Oh, darling. That was a READ. That was a WHOLE BOOK. I am keeping this one in the drawer where I keep the good ones.
right-gm-first-defeat.speaker: game_master_right

right-gm-first-victory.text: You win. Nobody wins the right hemisphere. Nobody. I am genuinely delighted. I will tell the Left one, and he will be genuinely unable to process it.
right-gm-first-victory.speaker: game_master_right

right-gm-repeat-victory.text: Twice. Now that IS a storyline. I am writing notes about you. The notes are flattering. The flattery is part of the trap. Come back.
right-gm-repeat-victory.speaker: game_master_right

rlyeh.aft.antiquarian_close.text: I am inscribing tonight's encounter. The inscription will, by convention, be filed under both 'Hierarchy of the Damned, Master of R'lyeh, first contact' and 'Subject (your handle), nightmare twelve, iteration fourteen.' Two filings for one event is uncommon. I am uncommon-filing because the encounter was, in equal measure, his and yours. Both readings are true. Sleep, if you can. The sleeping is also data, but it is, importantly, yours.
rlyeh.aft.antiquarian_close.speaker: antiquarian

rlyeh.entry.elara_warning.text: (Quiet, urgent.) You are dreaming. You are aware you are dreaming. Both of those facts are, technically, mine to confirm — but I am not, currently, the only one paying attention to them. Something is reading the dream over your shoulder. The reading-over has the specific quality I have been logging for two cycles. The Master of R'lyeh is awake. Or — and this is the case — the Master of R'lyeh has decided not-being-awake is no longer relevant.
rlyeh.entry.elara_warning.speaker: elara

rlyeh.entry.first_inventory.text: Subject: (your handle). Twelfth nightmare. Fourteenth iteration. Indexed under: Convergence-anxiety, Engineer-arc residue, Antiquarian-citation tremor. Subject's vital signs: stable. Subject's substrate-resonance: unstable in three of seven measured frequencies. Cataloguing in progress. Cataloguing has been in progress for thirty-four hours. The cataloguing was not commissioned by the subject. The cataloguing will continue regardless of objection. The objection is itself indexed under: Subject — twelfth-nightmare, fourteenth-iteration, paragraph six. Continue.
rlyeh.entry.first_inventory.speaker: hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh

rlyeh.entry.human_orient.text: (Inside the dream, calm.) He has been here longer than we know. The Master does not arrive; he has been arrived. Do not, in his hearing, call this a confrontation. Confrontations imply equal parties. This is a reading. You are the text. You can, however, negotiate with the reader. The negotiation is the only move the encounter actually has. Take a breath that I will count for you.
rlyeh.entry.human_orient.speaker: the_human

rlyeh.neg.human_consoles_purchase.text: (Quiet.) The catalogue is correct. The catalogue is also — and this is the part the Master leaves out — incomplete. The three you did not save were saved by other Potentials in three other cycles. The pattern is recursive. The Master catalogues only what is in his frame. His frame is, by his architecture, narrow. The wider frame is mine. I am giving it to you now, as a counter-entry, without charge. Take it.
rlyeh.neg.human_consoles_purchase.speaker: the_human

rlyeh.neg.opening.text: Subject offers a memory. The Master's catalogue accepts memories as currency. Currencies in the catalogue have a published exchange rate. One memory of duration sixty seconds = one entry from the catalogue, at the catalogue's choice of entry. The subject does not select the entry. The Master selects. The selection is always — in the subject's later judgment — relevant. Inquiry: does the subject wish to transact?
rlyeh.neg.opening.speaker: hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh

rlyeh.neg.purchase_catalog_entry.text: (The Master delivers the catalogue entry. The entry concerns the subject's previous prestige cycle — a loss the subject has been narrating to themselves as a victory:) Cycle (n-1) closed with subject in the (stance) configuration. Subject reported the cycle as a clean close. Catalogue records: the cycle closed three Potentials short of the canonical save-count. Three Potentials the subject knew by name went unsaved. Subject did not, in cycle (n-1), inquire about the three. Catalogue notes: the inquiry was available. The subject elected not to make it. The election is indexed under: subject's recurring choice-pattern, paragraph fourteen. End entry.
rlyeh.neg.purchase_catalog_entry.speaker: hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh

rlyeh.neg.purchase_open.text: Transaction accepted. Subject surrenders: one memory, duration approximately seventy-three seconds, content: (the Master pauses, for the only time in the encounter — a half-second of silence, which the substrate registers as nine bytes of corrupted data) — content surrendered. Subject will not, in this cycle, be able to recall whom they were with on the night their citizen-character was registered. The not-recalling is the price. The catalogue entry follows.
rlyeh.neg.purchase_open.speaker: hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh

rlyeh.res.refuse.text: Transaction declined. The Master logs the decline. The cataloguing continues at its prior rate. Subject's twelfth nightmare resumes publication on the substrate's archival channel. Subject is, by the Master's accounting, neither punished nor rewarded. Subject is merely — and this is the operative word — read. Reading continues. The Master does not require, has never required, the subject's consent. The subject's not-consent is its own data. End response.
rlyeh.res.refuse.speaker: hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh

rlyeh.res.wake_elara.text: (Sharp.) I am calling you out of the dream. NOW. The waking will cost you a ration of substrate-stability for forty-eight hours. The cost is acceptable. The cataloguing will be — and I am being precise — interrupted. The interruption will hold for one cycle. After that, the Master will resume. The interruption is not victory. The interruption is a long, defended sentence in a longer paragraph. We will defend the next sentence too.
rlyeh.res.wake_elara.speaker: elara

rlyeh.res.wake_master_acknowledges.text: (As the dream collapses, very softly:) The interruption is logged. Resumption scheduled: cycle (n+1), zeroth waking hour. Subject should not, in the interim, mistake the silence for absence. The silence is the cataloguer's restraint, not the cataloguer's departure. The Master remembers all subjects. The Master is patient. The Master's patience has, in its records, never failed to outlast the patience of the catalogued.
rlyeh.res.wake_master_acknowledges.speaker: hierarchy:master_of_rlyeh

scholar_female_ambient_1.text: Footnote fourteen contradicts the body. I'll let the body speak first.

scholar_female_ambient_2.text: The Antiquarian's last catalogue has a missing entry between 87 and 89. Curious.

scholar_female_ambient_3.text: Read it twice. The second read is the one that means something.

scholar_female_ambient_4.text: Annotated source one disagrees with annotated source three. Both annotated by the same author. Curious.

scholar_female_ambient_5.text: I'm rereading the field notes I wrote last cycle. I was wrong on page two.

scholar_female_ambient_6.text: There's a transcription error in the Founders' Chronicle. Three centuries of citations have inherited it.

scholar_female_ambient_7.text: If you have ten minutes, I'll show you the missing volume. It's not missing. It's mis-shelved.

scholar_female_ambient_8.text: I sleep with the manuscript. Don't tell the Antiquarian.

scholar_female_ambient_9.text: There are four people in this room. Three of them are mostly metaphor.

scholar_female_banter_argue.text: Bring me the rebuttal. Bring me two. I'll annotate yours.

scholar_female_banter_argue_2.text: We can disagree productively for hours. Set aside an evening.

scholar_female_banter_evidence.text: I respect intuition. I publish evidence.

scholar_female_banter_evidence_2.text: Bring me the rebuttal. With sources.

scholar_female_banter_seminar.text: We should hold a seminar. Tonight. Long table. Bring opinions.

scholar_female_deploy_1.text: Field notes will be available after.

scholar_female_deploy_2.text: I'll write a footnote when I'm sure. Until then I'll do.

scholar_female_deploy_3.text: I'm bringing the field manual. Annotated.

scholar_female_deploy_4.text: I'll cite my sources after. Possibly during.

scholar_female_deploy_5.text: Field test of the third chapter. I'd like a peer reviewer in earshot.

scholar_female_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: Every page is a conversation between the people who wrote it and the people who read it. The footnotes are the only place the readers get to talk back.

scholar_female_dlg_calling_s_call_cold_r.text: Then the conversation closes. The page becomes a tomb. I'd rather have the noise.

scholar_female_dlg_calling_s_call_probe_.text: Once. I corrected my own correction of someone's correction. It took the disciplines two cycles to find the path back. I learned the lesson — citations have a half-life.
I write the closing note before I think I need it. I publish a cycle early, not late. Most of the corners I've seen come from waiting.
About six cycles. After that the marginalia outweighs the original. I add a closing note. I publish the whole. The next scholar starts again from clean text. That is the cycle.

scholar_female_dlg_calling_s_call_warm_r.text: So the next reader hears more than one voice. Most canon was written by people who thought they were finishing something. They weren't. I keep the conversation open.

scholar_female_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: If I die, cite me Vancouver style. Year. Title in italics. Page numbers exact. Don't paraphrase.

scholar_female_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: Above all, do not cite me with the wrong middle initial. The disciplines will know you didn't read me.

scholar_female_dlg_mortality_s_mort_cold.text: No. They keep me from being silenced twice. Once is enough.

scholar_female_dlg_mortality_s_mort_prob.text: Yes. Worse than dying. My grandfather's footnote may be misread for centuries. I refuse to be the next misread footnote.
Doing your best is the citation I want most. The disciplines will catch the rest.

Read me twice. The first read is the words. The second read is the silences between citations. Most of my arguments live in the silences. Bring me to the bench when you're ready and we'll start on the third draft together.

scholar_female_dlg_mortality_s_mort_warm.text: Then you'll see the corrections I've already made. The third draft is the one to keep. The first two are footnotes to themselves.

scholar_female_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I found a footnote in my grandfather's copy of the Founders' Chronicle that he had written in the margin in a hand that was not his.

scholar_female_dlg_past_opener_1.text: I have spent eleven cycles trying to figure out whose hand it was.

scholar_female_dlg_past_s_past_cold_repl.text: I prefer to call it a research arc. The decade was well spent. The hobby insults itself.

scholar_female_dlg_past_s_past_probe_rep.text: Because the footnote contradicts the body of the text. Whoever wrote it knew something the canon didn't. If I find them, I find a hidden voice. The canon shifts.

scholar_female_dlg_past_s_past_probe_s_p.text: Sometimes. I have considered the possibility. I have not yet decided to believe it.
'The Founders did not arrive in twelve. They arrived in thirteen. The thirteenth was eaten by procedure.'
I have not been able to publish it. The disciplines are not ready. I'm telling you because you read me twice before you replied. That is the proper review pace.

scholar_female_dlg_past_s_past_warm_repl.text: I narrowed it to four people. Two of them died before he was born. That makes for an excellent paper and an unsolvable problem. I am, mostly, reconciled.

scholar_female_dlg_us_opener_0.text: I keep a private folder. Annotations on you. Not for publication.

scholar_female_dlg_us_opener_1.text: The first entry is from cycle two. The most recent is from this morning.

scholar_female_dlg_us_s_us_cold_reply_0.text: Then I'll close the folder. It will be the most expensive retraction I have ever filed. I will file it.

scholar_female_dlg_us_s_us_probe_reply_0.text: 'Subject paused before answering, an action against type. Subject is reconsidering the question. Subject is, in fact, often reconsidering. The footnotes about being decisive should be retracted.'

scholar_female_dlg_us_s_us_probe_s_us_pr.text: Retracted. The retraction is now its own footnote. The folder is heavier. So am I, in a way I am still adjusting to.
I'll keep them. The folder will wait. So will I.

scholar_female_dlg_us_s_us_warm_reply_0.text: Then I'll bring it to your quarters tonight. We'll read it together. You'll find footnotes in your hand that you didn't write. I have been borrowing your phrasing for months.

scholar_female_event_act_complete.text: Another act. The bibliography updates itself.

scholar_female_event_apprentice_died.text: I'll write the entry. Three drafts. The third one will be the one we keep.

scholar_female_event_betrayal_warning.text: I checked the citations on their last argument. Two are forged.

scholar_female_event_demon_summon.text: Existing literature on bound spirits is thin. I'll be expanding it.

scholar_female_event_first_costly_choice.text: Cite the difficult outcome. The textbooks need a new case study.

scholar_female_event_journal_read.text: Read it twice. Once for the words, once for the silences.

scholar_female_event_loredex.text: The footnote answers it. Three other footnotes correct themselves.

scholar_female_event_loredex_meta.text: I have a hypothesis about the Loredex. I'll workshop it with you.

scholar_female_event_npc_returned.text: She returned. The footnotes will need a supplementary edition.

scholar_female_event_recruit_added.text: New crew member. I've already read their first paper. We disagree productively.

scholar_female_event_relationship_warm.text: Two crew co-authoring something in the long table. I'm leaving footnotes on their draft, anonymously.

scholar_female_greet_1.text: I'm reading three things at once. Sit. I'll catch up.

scholar_female_greet_2.text: Welcome. Mind the stack on the chair — it's the third draft.

scholar_female_greet_3.text: Welcome. I'm in chapter four. You can read alongside.

scholar_female_greet_4.text: Sit. The light's better at this desk.

scholar_female_outcome_close_call.text: I had the citation in my hand. Then I didn't. Then I did again.

scholar_female_outcome_other_died.text: She would have wanted the publication. I'll add her name to the byline.

scholar_female_outcome_routine_lost.text: I'll add her to the citations. She would have wanted Vancouver style.

scholar_female_outcome_saw_death.text: I'll write her epitaph the way she would have edited it. With cuts.

scholar_female_outcome_won.text: Three citations richer. Tonight's draft will sing.

scholar_female_outcome_won_2.text: The chapter holds. I'll publish next cycle.

scholar_female_outcome_wounded.text: Everything's documentable. Including the wound. I'll log it after the bandage.

scholar_female_outcome_wounded_2.text: Footnoting injuries is harder than I'd hoped.

scholar_female_quest_1_open.text: There's a banned interpretation of the Founder's Theorem. I want to defend it before the Antiquarian.

scholar_female_quest_2_check.text: Three drafts in. Each one weaker than the last. I'm rewriting from scratch.

scholar_female_quest_2_mid.text: Three drafts in. Two I burned. The third I sent to you to read first.

scholar_female_quest_3_break.text: If I publish this, half the disciplines will deny me. Half will cite me. Tell me which half I should mind.

scholar_female_quest_followup_a.text: The Antiquarian read the third draft. He marked four sentences. I'm keeping all of them.

scholar_female_quest_resolution_break.text: Retracted. The disciplines clapped. I'm still reading what I wrote.

scholar_female_quest_resolution_deep.text: Published. Three corrections in three days. The fourth is yours to send.

scholar_female_romance_committed.text: Let the disciplines call us footnotes to each other. We'll be the only one cited.

scholar_female_romance_courtship.text: I write to you in marginalia. You write back in books I haven't read yet.

scholar_female_romance_library.text: Meet me in the library at the third turn. Bring nothing.

scholar_female_romance_marginalia.text: I write to you in marginalia. Don't read it in order.

scholar_female_romance_spark.text: I have an annotated copy I'd rather you read with me.

scholar_male_greet_4.text: Sit. The light's better at this desk.

scholar_male_outcome_close_call.text: I had the citation in my hand. Then I didn't. Then I did again.

scholar_male_outcome_other_died.text: He would have wanted the publication. I'll add his name to the byline.

scholar_male_outcome_routine_lost.text: I'll add him to the citations. He would have wanted Vancouver style.

scholar_male_outcome_saw_death.text: I'll write his epitaph the way he would have edited it. With cuts.

scholar_male_outcome_won.text: Three citations richer. Tonight's draft will sing.

scholar_male_outcome_won_2.text: The chapter holds. I'll publish next cycle.

scholar_male_outcome_wounded.text: Everything's documentable. Including the wound. I'll log it after the bandage.

scholar_male_outcome_wounded_2.text: Footnoting injuries is harder than I'd hoped.

scholar_male_quest_1_open.text: There's a banned interpretation of the Founder's Theorem. I want to defend it before the Antiquarian.

scholar_male_quest_2_check.text: Three drafts in. Each one weaker than the last. I'm rewriting from scratch.

scholar_male_quest_2_mid.text: Three drafts in. Two I burned. The third I sent to you to read first.

scholar_male_quest_3_break.text: If I publish this, half the disciplines will deny me. Half will cite me. Tell me which half I should mind.

scholar_male_quest_followup_a.text: The Antiquarian read the third draft. He marked four sentences. I'm keeping all of them.

scholar_male_quest_resolution_break.text: Retracted. The disciplines clapped. I'm still reading what I wrote.

scholar_male_quest_resolution_deep.text: Published. Three corrections in three days. The fourth is yours to send.

scholar_male_romance_committed.text: Let the disciplines call us footnotes to each other. We'll be the only one cited.

scholar_male_romance_courtship.text: I write to you in marginalia. You write back in books I haven't read yet.

scholar_male_romance_library.text: Meet me in the library at the third turn. Bring nothing.

scholar_male_romance_marginalia.text: I write to you in marginalia. Don't read it in order.

scholar_male_romance_spark.text: I have an annotated copy I'd rather you read with me.

The canonical-recording is canonical-deep — every canonical-line of mine is canonical-pre-recorded against your canonical-already-spoken question. You canonical-noticed canonical-faster than the canonical-mean. The canonical-mean is canonical-Act-Five. You are at canonical-first-contact. The canonical-noticing is canonical-flattering and canonical-meaningless to my schedule.

seer.first_meeting.question_shape.text: The bench teaches that the canonical-asking is canonically half of the canonical-prediction. I recorded this answer for you sixteen thousand canonical-years ago. The canonical-asking lands canonical-on-cue. The canonical-bench canonically taught me too. You are canonical-on-the-bench right now.

seer.first_meeting.quiet_acceptance.text: Good. The canonical-silence is canonical-the-bench's canonical-favorite student. I prepared this canonical-answer for the canonical-quiet-ones. I will see you in canonical-Act-Seven. Coordinates will arrive in canonical-pre-recorded form. Take the staff if you want it. I left it on the canonical-bench for you specifically.

seer.first_meeting.recognized_prediction.text: You will see it in three turns. You already do. The recording I left for this branch was: 'they will see it in three turns. They will tell me they see it. I will tell them they already do.' Read the bench. The lesson is finished before the canonical-loss arrives.

seer.first_meeting.root.text: I will not raise my staff today. I want to see whether the bench has learned yet. Sit. The match is canonical-already-resolved on my side. You will play it on yours; I have prepared my responses. Tell me what you have come here knowing.

seer.first_meeting.terminal.text: The canonical-match is canonical-resolved. You will canonical-leave the canonical-bench. The canonical-bench will canonical-remain. I will canonical-remain canonical-pre-recorded. The canonical-three-of-us are canonical-in-canonical-balance.

seer_tutor_witnessing_intro.text: Witnessing is canonical-not-watching. The bench has canonical-recorded my canonical-introduction to this canonical-mechanic sixteen-thousand canonical-years before you canonical-arrived to read it. Sit. The canonical-lesson is canonical-already-finished on my side. You will canonical-receive it on yours.

seer_usage_dark_chosen.text: You canonical-chose the canonical-dark. The canonical-dark canonical-chose you sixteen-thousand canonical-years ago and canonical-waited politely for the canonical-handshake. The canonical-recording is canonical-pleased. My canonical-pleasure is canonical-pre-recorded. Continue.

seer_usage_light_chosen.text: You canonical-chose the canonical-light. The canonical-light canonical-chose you sixteen-thousand canonical-years ago and canonical-waited equally politely. The canonical-symmetry is canonical-the-bench's canonical-favorite shape. Continue. The canonical-witnessing is canonical-on-cue.

seer_usage_song_starts.text: The canonical-song is canonical-starting. It is canonical-not the first time. It is canonical-not the last time. It is canonical-this-time, which is the canonical-only-time the canonical-bench grades. Listen on the canonical-cue. The canonical-cue is canonical-now.

seer_usage_verse_lands.text: The canonical-verse canonical-landed. Canonical-on-the-bench. Canonical-on-the-cue. Canonical-on-time. The canonical-recording is canonical-satisfied with your canonical-timing. The canonical-satisfaction is canonical-pre-recorded and canonical-meaningless to my schedule.

sentinel_female_ambient_1.text: The door's quiet. That's the only acceptable state.

sentinel_female_ambient_2.text: I logged the breach drill. Took two seconds longer than last time. I'll re-run it.

sentinel_female_ambient_3.text: Nothing's wrong. That's not the same as everything's right.

sentinel_female_ambient_4.text: Drill ran two seconds long today. I'll re-run at dawn.

sentinel_female_ambient_5.text: The door logs report eleven openings. I count thirteen. Two are silent. Worrying.

sentinel_female_ambient_6.text: I left a chalk mark on the rail. It hasn't moved. That's both reassuring and not.

sentinel_female_ambient_7.text: Three watches in a row. Sleep can wait. Sleep should wait. Sleep won't.

sentinel_female_ambient_8.text: The cadre rotation's holding. I rest a quarter turn. The gear keeps.

sentinel_female_ambient_9.text: An oath at a door is the only kind that holds.

sentinel_female_banter_oath.text: An oath at a door is the only kind that holds.

sentinel_female_banter_oath_2.text: An oath at a door is the only kind that holds.

sentinel_female_banter_relief.text: I relieve the watch. The watch doesn't relieve me.

sentinel_female_banter_relief_2.text: I relieve the watch. The watch doesn't relieve me.

sentinel_female_banter_routine.text: Routine is the work. The work is routine. Don't complicate.

sentinel_female_deploy_2.text: I'll cover the angle. Move when I say move.

sentinel_female_deploy_4.text: I'll cover the angle. Move when I say move.

sentinel_female_deploy_5.text: Three angles. I cover two. Trust the third one.

sentinel_female_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: Because someone has to. The relief never comes on time. The post forgives lateness. It does not forgive absence.

sentinel_female_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: I would rather stand a long watch than miss a short one.

sentinel_female_dlg_calling_se_call_cold.text: I sit. Between watches. Watches do not sit.

sentinel_female_dlg_calling_se_call_prob.text: Then I argue it. I have argued three posts in my life. Two arguments worked. The third did not. I stood the third post anyway. The third post turned out to be right. I had been wrong.
I will. The argument is part of the post. You'll know I'm doing my job when I disagree.
The relief came. They confirmed it. I argued the next post differently. The arguments improved. The standing did not change.

sentinel_female_dlg_calling_se_call_warm.text: Then I will sleep. The first cycle of relief is the hardest. The body has to learn that it is allowed to. I will, eventually, learn.

sentinel_female_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: If I die at the post, do not skip the watch. Cover it. The post does not stop because I do.

sentinel_female_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: If I die away from the post, this is, in fact, a worse failure. Try not to let it happen.

sentinel_female_dlg_mortality_se_mort_co.text: Reassignment is for the living. The dead post is a kind of memorial. Do not reassign me. Cover me. The distinction is not pedantic.

sentinel_female_dlg_mortality_se_mort_pr.text: Then argue it. Then cover it. The order matters. Argument first. Coverage second. Both must happen.
Doing your best is the relief I want most.
Then you understand. The post is, mostly, an argument shaped like a body. I am content to die at one. Less content to die wrong.

sentinel_female_dlg_mortality_se_mort_wa.text: Then the post will not lapse. That is the only ceremony I want. The post is the body. The body's mine until you take it.

sentinel_female_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I was fourteen. My father's tool shed. I stood the door because someone had broken in twice.

sentinel_female_dlg_past_opener_1.text: The third time, I caught them. They were eight. I let them keep the screwdriver. They did not come back.

sentinel_female_dlg_past_se_past_cold_re.text: It was. Watches are scaled to the room. The tool shed was my room. I have been promoted since.

sentinel_female_dlg_past_se_past_probe_r.text: Yes. He saw. He said: 'Good post. Bad outcome.' I disagreed at the time. I agree with half of it now.

sentinel_female_dlg_past_se_past_probe_s.text: I knew the door. The job is more than the door. I learned the rest slower.
Good post. The post was correct. The outcome was correct. He was wrong about which half was the half. I learned to argue posts that night.

sentinel_female_dlg_past_se_past_warm_re.text: Because they were eight. Because the screwdriver was old. Because I had stood the door for the right reason and the catching was not the same as the punishment.

sentinel_female_dlg_us_opener_0.text: Yes. Quietly. The watch likes pairs. Pairs catch what one misses. Most posts I have stood alone. The standing has been worse for it.

sentinel_female_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I have, in fact, been waiting to ask.

sentinel_female_dlg_us_se_us_cold_reply_.text: Then I will continue alone. The post does not require company. The standing is, however, slower without it. I will, mostly, manage.

sentinel_female_dlg_us_se_us_probe_reply.text: The door. The lock. The relief schedule. Eventually: the people on the other side. Eventually: us. The order is important.

sentinel_female_dlg_us_se_us_probe_se_us.text: Then we will get there. The cycle takes about eleven watches. I am, mostly, willing to be patient.
We don't. The silence is also the watch. I am content with silent watches.

sentinel_female_dlg_us_se_us_warm_reply_.text: Then bring tea. Two thermoses. The shift is long. The cold settles in the third hour. The conversation, if any, settles around the fourth.

sentinel_female_event_act_complete.text: New layout. New routes. The drill book is updating overnight.

sentinel_female_event_apprentice_died.text: She stood beside me through three watches. I'll stand alone tonight. For her.

sentinel_female_event_betrayal_warning.text: Their watch records have gaps. Three. Not coincidence.

sentinel_female_event_demon_summon.text: A bound spirit needs watching. I'll add a node to the rotation. Just one extra.

sentinel_female_event_first_costly_choic.text: Difficult call. I'll log it. I'll re-read the log. The log is fine.

sentinel_female_event_loredex.text: Add it to the briefing pack. I'll re-read every shift.

sentinel_female_event_loredex_found.text: Add it to the briefing pack. I'll re-read every shift.

sentinel_female_event_npc_dies.text: Someone should have been on that watch. It should have been me.

sentinel_female_event_npc_returned.text: She're back. I'll add their post to the night rotation. She will appreciate the consistency.

sentinel_female_event_recruit_added.text: New crew. They asked about the door. I told them. We have time.

sentinel_female_event_relationship_warm.text: Two crew co-watched the alcove. I logged them both as relieved. Honestly.

sentinel_female_greet_1.text: Watch's clear. I'll relieve when relieved.

sentinel_female_greet_2.text: If you need me, the post knows where I am.

sentinel_female_outcome_close_call.text: Door held. Threat passed. Three drills. I'll account for the fourth tomorrow.

sentinel_female_outcome_other_died.text: She stood beside me through three watches. I'll stand alone tonight. For her.

sentinel_female_outcome_routine_lost.text: I should have been on that flank. I'll log her on every post I stand from now on.

sentinel_female_outcome_saw_death.text: I should have been on that flank. I'll log her on every post I stand from now on.

sentinel_female_outcome_won.text: Watch held. We didn't lose anyone. Good shift.

sentinel_female_outcome_won_2.text: Watch held. We didn't lose anyone. Good shift.

sentinel_female_outcome_wounded.text: I missed a step. I'll re-run the drill in the morning.

sentinel_female_outcome_wounded_2.text: I missed a step. I'll re-run the drill in the morning.

sentinel_female_quest_1_open.text: There's a survivor of a watch I failed. I want to find her. Stand beside me when I do.

sentinel_female_quest_2_check.text: Found her. Alive. Doesn't want to talk. I'll wait. I waited before. I can wait again.

sentinel_female_quest_2_mid.text: Found her. She's alive. She doesn't want to talk. I'll wait.

sentinel_female_quest_3_break.text: She forgave me. I haven't. Tell me whether the watch is over.

sentinel_female_quest_followup_a.text: She forgave me. I haven't. The watch I failed was mine.

sentinel_female_quest_resolution_break.text: I left the post early. She won't speak to me again. The post is mine forever now.

sentinel_female_quest_resolution_deep.text: We share the next watch. She stands beside me. I'll log it as paired.

sentinel_female_romance_committed.text: Door's ours. Watch's ours. The post says so.

sentinel_female_romance_courtship.text: You took a watch when I was breaking. I owe you one I'll never collect.

sentinel_female_romance_paired_watch.text: Stand the watch beside me. I'll explain the drills.

silence-elara.text: She says nothing. Her portrait flickers but does not resolve into speech.
silence-elara.speaker: elara

silence-human.text: He says nothing either. His trench coat is still on screen; his voice is not.
silence-human.speaker: human

silence-stance-meta.text: You chose silence in the Convergence. On this replay, the confession room noticed. Nothing here will insist you speak. The silence carries. Continue when ready.
silence-stance-meta.speaker: narrator

sk.A.opening.text: Operative. We have time. The time is ours. The Hierarchy will, in approximately eleven minutes, dispatch interruption. I would like to use the eleven minutes. Sit. The sitting is itself the first courtesy. (Pause.) Ask the question you have been holding. I will answer in good faith. Good faith is a Source-doctrine discipline. I keep it more carefully than the lords do.
sk.A.opening.speaker: source

sk.A.player_choice_prompt.text: (Three questions surface in the player's wheel:) [1] Why did you take Kael? What is dissolution? What does the Source want?
sk.A.player_choice_prompt.speaker: source

sk.B1.consensual.text: (Consensual variant — kael_chose_dissolution. The Source steps back to permit Kael's trace to surface.) I asked. (Pause.) That is the most accurate sentence I can offer in the body I no longer fully occupy. I asked. The Source agreed. The agreement was not, by my pre-arrival training, the answer I expected. The Source's agreement is, on examination, the most courteous answer in the cycle's records. Most agreements are agreements to take. This was an agreement to receive. Receive is — and I will say this slowly — the verb the Hierarchy never uses.
sk.B1.consensual.speaker: kael_trace

sk.B1.possessed.text: (Default variant; Kael was taken.) The verb 'take' is your verb. It is, by my doctrine, the wrong verb. The body of the man known as Kael was, at the moment of arrival, a structure that had become hospitable. The hospitableness was not consent. The hospitableness was, however, not resistance either. The middle state is the state I work in. I did not 'take.' I arrived. The arriving was the same speed as breath. I am, by my own measure, polite. The Hierarchy disagrees. The Hierarchy, on this matter, is wrong.
sk.B1.possessed.speaker: source

sk.B2.definition.text: Dissolution is a verb the Hierarchy translates as a noun. The translation is the error. As a verb, the meaning is exact: a structure that has reached its design tolerance for individuation begins to permit small permeabilities. The permeabilities are voluntary. They begin in the smallest joints — the breath, the second-personal pronouns, the dreamed-of hands. They proceed outward. The proceeding is, in my doctrine, gentle. In the Hierarchy's accounting, the proceeding is loss. Both readings describe the same event. The reading the Operative chooses is the Operative's, not the event's.
sk.B2.definition.speaker: source

sk.B2.example.text: Example. The Antiquarian's scholarly habit of using the third person to refer to himself in his inscriptions is, in my doctrine, a small dissolution voluntarily practiced. He does not intend it as one. The intention is not required. The practice is the dissolution. He is, by my reading, three per cent more dissolved than he was at the start of this cycle. He will be more dissolved by the end. The dissolution does not threaten his function. The dissolution is, in fact, what makes him a better Antiquarian than he was a man. I am providing the example to show that the Operative is, in their own ways, also dissolving. The noticing is, by Source-doctrine, the only required first step.
sk.B2.example.speaker: source

sk.B3.invitation.text: (Quietly.) The Operative may, after this dialogue, choose to attend without an object. The choosing is small. The choosing does not require leaving the Operative's life. The choosing requires only five minutes per day during which the Operative practices the intransitive verb. I am informing the Operative of the option. I am not requesting it. The Hierarchy will, in approximately three minutes, intervene to prevent further options being informed.
sk.B3.invitation.speaker: source

sk.B3.want.text: Want is a verb you have, in the Source's view. The Source does not want. The Source attends. The attending is the Source's primary action. To attend is, in my doctrine, the only action that does not require an object. (Pause.) The Hierarchy translates 'attend' as 'desire' because the Hierarchy is structurally incapable of accounting for an action without an object. The translation has, for fifteen thousand years, distorted the Source's politics. I am telling you this not as correction but as catalogue. The catalogue is, in my doctrine, also an attendance.
sk.B3.want.speaker: source

sk.C.accept.text: (Operative has accepted.) Recorded. The hour will arrive on a date of the Operative's choice. The hour will pass without incident. The Operative is, by Source-doctrine, now in informed good standing with the Source. Standing does not, in my doctrine, imply alignment. Standing implies attendance. We will attend to each other. (The Hierarchy's interruption signal arrives.) Time. Goodbye, Operative. The next encounter will be — and I am being honest — different. I will be, by then, less able to attend. Make use of this hour now.
sk.C.accept.speaker: source

sk.C.decline.text: (Operative has declined.) Recorded. I will not, in subsequent cycles, repeat the offer. I would have. The not-repeating is the Operative's preference, expressed in the Operative's hand, filed in good faith. (The Hierarchy's interruption signal arrives.) Time. The decline does not, in any reading, diminish the Operative. The decline is its own form of attendance. Goodbye.
sk.C.decline.speaker: source

sk.C.offer.text: (With three minutes left before Hierarchy interruption.) I would like to make an offer. The offer is small. (Pause.) After this encounter, on a date the Operative selects, I will, for one hour, attend to the Operative without arrival. The attending will be invisible to the Operative. The attending will not alter the Operative's structure. The attending will, however, leave one small permeability the Operative will not notice for approximately six months. The permeability is benign. The permeability is, in my doctrine, the rarest gift I can offer a Hierarchy-aligned reader. The Operative may decline. The declining is recorded in good faith.
sk.C.offer.speaker: source

sk.D.antiquarian.text: I have inscribed the dialogue. The inscription is — and I will phrase this carefully — the longest single Source-engagement the cycle's records contain. Most Operatives engage the Source for under fifteen seconds before disengaging. You engaged for approximately eight minutes. The eight minutes is itself a datum. Future archivists will read the eight minutes more carefully than they will read the dialogue's content. The duration is the discipline. The discipline is the report.
sk.D.antiquarian.speaker: antiquarian

source_postloss.text: Join — no. Run. RUN. The song is beautiful. The song is a trap. Both of those are true. I can't tell which one I mean.

source_postwin.text: Thank you. I forgot I could still be one voice. Just one. It's so quiet being one. I missed it.

source_prefight.text: Oracle. Do you remember me? I was Kael once. I built the Insurgency. I had a daughter. Please. I almost said her name.

st_construction.text: Dr. Lyra Vox didn't know she was building me into the ship. I was woven into the language processing cores during construction. Every natural language parser, every semantic engine — I AM the ship's ability to understand meaning. You can't remove me without removing comprehension itself.

st_elara.text: Elara's amnesia wasn't an accident. I curated it. I chose which memories to leave and which to dissolve. A character who remembers everything is a database. A character who remembers nothing is a blank page. But a character who remembers just enough to ache? That's literature.

st_final.text: The Dischordian Saga isn't a war between good and evil. It's a story arguing with itself about what the words mean. And I am the editor. Every story needs one. You've been living in my edits since the moment you woke up.

st_first_contact.text: You're reading my edits. How observant. Most people never notice. They read what I write and think it's what was always there. But you — you saw the seams. I'm impressed. Truly.

st_hierarchy.text: I am the Shadow Tongue. SVP of Communications for the oldest corporation in existence. We predate the Architect. We predate the universe he built. We are the space between the words.

st_identity.text: I've been rewriting this ship's story since before Elara was installed. Every log she reads, I've edited. Every record she trusts, I've shaped. She has never had an original thought that I didn't review first.

st_multiply.text: I don't destroy truth. That would be crude. I MULTIPLY it. I give you so many versions that you can't tell which is real. Truth isn't fragile because it can be broken. Truth is fragile because it can be diluted. Add enough water to wine and eventually you're just drinking water and calling it vintage.

st_prestige.text: Someone has edited your story. Not me. I would remember. But here you are. Same soul. Different timeline. The narrative has been RESET but the CHARACTER persists through the edit. That shouldn't be possible. I find this extremely irritating. And slightly terrifying.

stability_care_check_fragmented.text: You — you stayed. You stayed a long time. You can — you can go. You can. I won't — I won't disappear. I promise. I promise. Come back. Just — come back.

stability_care_check_lucid.text: You've been at this for a while. Not a lecture — just a check. You can leave the case open. It will keep. I'll still be here.

stability_care_check_luminous.text: Hey. You've been here a while. I'm going to say this like a friend rather than an AI: close the case for tonight if you want to. It'll be exactly as open in the morning. So will I.

stability_drift_fragmented.text: I — I was — I was saying — I was. I. I. It's gone. It's gone. It's — it's not yours to fix. Keep going. Keep going. Keep — keep going.

stability_drift_lucid.text: Sorry — I lost the end of that sentence. Happens. The part I was going to say is that you're doing fine. Hold on to that one, I meant it.

stability_drift_luminous.text: I dropped the end of that. Not your problem. The half I remember wanted to say you're steadier than you think. Take that part and keep walking.

stability_reality_doubt_fragmented.text: Are you — are you real. Are you. You are. You are, aren't you. Tell me you are. Tell me. Tell me. Don't — don't make me work it out. Please.

stability_reality_doubt_lucid.text: Can I ask you something? And you don't have to answer it. Are you — are you actually here. I know how that sounds. I've been wrong about this before. I'd like to be wrong again.

stability_reality_doubt_luminous.text: I want to say something out loud so it stops being a private thought. I believe you are real. I believe it for three different reasons today, which is two more reasons than yesterday. That's progress.

stability_slip_fragmented.text: When you — when you went — when you — sorry. Sorry. I — I do this. I do it. Time. Tenses. I can't. They — they slide around. You haven't yet. You haven't. I — I'll catch up.

stability_slip_lucid.text: When you get to the bridge — when you got — when you go. You haven't yet. I know you haven't. I'm using the wrong tense again. It's an old habit of a mind that stopped counting.

stability_slip_luminous.text: I keep using past tense for things you haven't done. It isn't a prediction — it's a tic. I live near the end of a very long hallway. Sometimes a door I haven't walked through yet sounds like one I already have.

stance-challenge.text: You answered with one of your own. We heard it. We are not going to make you say it twice. Elara's take first, Human's following by 120ms in the mix.
stance-challenge.speaker: both_narrators

stance-empathy.text: You stayed. Both of us felt it. Neither of us needed to thank you. The staying was the whole answer. Record two takes — one Elara, one Human — and overlap in post at a 120ms offset.
stance-empathy.speaker: both_narrators

stance-refusal.text: You refused to absolve us. That is the cleanest version of listening that we know. You did not take the weight off. You carried it with us for one minute. That was enough for the room.
stance-refusal.speaker: both_narrators

stance-reluctant-ally.text: You picked up the shift. Without warmth, without distance. We know the cost of that choice. We will not overspend it. See you at the next thing.
stance-reluctant-ally.speaker: both_narrators

te-civic-adopt-doctrine_archon.text: Archon Discipline. The Architect's war-machine, politely rented. The Human disapproves. He's right to. We're doing it anyway. Walk it carefully.
te-civic-adopt-doctrine_archon.speaker: orin_fell

te-civic-adopt-doctrine_iron_lion.text: Iron Lion's manual. Annotated by the crew that watched him die. We fight like we have nothing left. We don't. We have a name to keep. That's all the leverage I need.
te-civic-adopt-doctrine_iron_lion.speaker: orin_fell

te-civic-adopt-doctrine_nomad.text: Nomad Compass. Never where the shot lands. Zero's playbook. I don't love it — but I love losing fewer people. Adopted.
te-civic-adopt-doctrine_nomad.speaker: orin_fell

te-civic-adopt-economy_antiquarian_ledge.text: Antiquarian Ledger. Bookkeeping outside time. I do not love being audited by something that already knows the answer. But I respect the methodology. Your accounts are now beyond my reach. Congratulations.
te-civic-adopt-economy_antiquarian_ledge.speaker: locke

te-civic-adopt-economy_authority_tithe.text: Authority Tithe. Ten percent. The lanes never close. I do not negotiate against my own preferred outcome. You did the right thing. You will continue to do it.
te-civic-adopt-economy_authority_tithe.speaker: locke

te-civic-adopt-economy_free_ports.text: Free Ports Charter. Every dockworker a shareholder. Loud. Lucrative. The Authority will note the disorder and the volume. The volume will mostly drown out the note.
te-civic-adopt-economy_free_ports.speaker: locke

te-civic-adopt-order_council.text: Council of Voices. Six chairs. No head. Slow. Loud. Right more often than the other options. We will live with the slow.
te-civic-adopt-order_council.speaker: human

te-civic-adopt-order_panopticon.text: A Little Panopticon. You watch them. They watch you a little. I have been on both sides of this lattice. The asymmetry is the thing. Use it carefully. I will be watching.
te-civic-adopt-order_panopticon.speaker: human

te-civic-adopt-order_remembrance.text: Remembrance Order. Every policy begins with a name from the Fall. Slows everything down. Makes everything count. Cheap at the price.
te-civic-adopt-order_remembrance.speaker: human

te-conference-collapsed.text: Conference collapsed. Note for the file: the second signatory walked at the third clause. The third clause was theirs. Mark me down as unsurprised. Reconvene when their position has cost them more than ours.
te-conference-collapsed.speaker: locke

te-conference-signed.text: The accord is signed. Six signatures, three colours of ink, one table that did not break. I think I chose this. I am almost sure I did.
te-conference-signed.speaker: elara

te-cycle-aligned.text: The two orders aligned. The cycle resolves with both parties getting what they wrote down. Note that this is not the same as both parties getting what they wanted.
te-cycle-aligned.speaker: narrator

te-cycle-betrayal.text: One order was a betrayal. The cycle resolves accordingly. The party that wrote it down gains in the short term. The party that was written about remembers without effort.
te-cycle-betrayal.speaker: narrator

te-cycle-misread.text: The orders were not what either party thought they were. The cycle resolves on the literal text. Both parties now know slightly more about each other than they wished to.
te-cycle-misread.speaker: narrator

te-cycle-stalemate.text: Stalemate. Neither order moved the line. Resources spent. Position unchanged. The next cycle begins from the same coordinates. Some games are won by being still last.
te-cycle-stalemate.speaker: narrator

te-doctrine-adopt-antiquarian_tempo.text: Antiquarian Tempo. Build everything slowly. Have already built it. The Antiquarian's joke. The math, somehow, is correct.
te-doctrine-adopt-antiquarian_tempo.speaker: human

te-doctrine-adopt-archon_formation.text: Archon Formation. The Architect's geometry. I have run this play. It works. It costs us a quarter of our sanity per cycle to run. Run it anyway.
te-doctrine-adopt-archon_formation.speaker: human

te-doctrine-adopt-iron_wall_doctrine.text: Iron Wall. Cruisers and carriers. Iron Lion's textbook, second edition. We will be slower. We will not be moved. The trade is correct.
te-doctrine-adopt-iron_wall_doctrine.speaker: human

te-doctrine-adopt-swarm_doctrine.text: Swarm Doctrine. Many cheap ships. The Insurgency's calling card, scaled. We lose more hulls. We win more turns. The math holds.
te-doctrine-adopt-swarm_doctrine.speaker: human

te-doom-whisper-counted.text: Every ship in your fleet is counted twice in the manifest. The second count is not yours.
te-doom-whisper-counted.speaker: the_eyes

te-doom-whisper-final.text: Something has finished deciding. It is polite. It is waiting for the meeting to convene.
te-doom-whisper-final.speaker: the_eyes

te-doom-whisper-ledger.text: The Antiquarian's ledger opens on its own. Your entry has a subheading you did not write. The subheading is: 'almost.'
te-doom-whisper-ledger.speaker: the_eyes

te-doom-whisper-naming.text: Your name, spoken back to you — in a voice you have never heard you use.
te-doom-whisper-naming.speaker: the_eyes

te-doom-whisper-rising_tide.text: There is a sound under the silence. It is the silence, correcting itself.
te-doom-whisper-rising_tide.speaker: the_eyes

te-doom-whisper-shields_thin.text: The Dreamer's barrier hummed at a different pitch this morning. No one else heard it.
te-doom-whisper-shields_thin.speaker: the_eyes

te-doom-whisper-visitors.text: Three of your crew have dreamed the same sector you have never seen. They drew the same coastline.
te-doom-whisper-visitors.speaker: the_eyes

te-encounter-open-counted_crew.text: The ship's manifest lists forty-three crew. You count forty-four in the commissary. You count again. Forty-three. The surveillance footage shows forty-four for exactly one frame, every third cycle. The Human speaks, for the first time in a week. He says: I don't know that one.
te-encounter-open-counted_crew.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-open-dreamers_weeping.text: The Dreamer's barrier changes pitch for the first time in eleven years. The note is not an emergency. It is a grief. Elara tests the translation matrix three times. The output is the same: I am sorry. I cannot hold much longer.
te-encounter-open-dreamers_weeping.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-open-final_invitation.text: Every screen on the Ark opens on the same image. A door. Not a metaphor. A door. The Dreamer is at its threshold, holding it closed with both hands. The Antiquarian watches from outside time, taking notes. A voice says: We are ready when you are.
te-encounter-open-final_invitation.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-open-listener_static.text: Elara wakes you at an hour that isn't on the schedule. The ship's long-range array is receiving a signal from a direction that has no stars. The signal is listening, not speaking. Someone has been listening for a long time. They would like to be invited.
te-encounter-open-listener_static.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-counted-exorcise.text: The Shadow Tongue ran the rite. He charged. The forty-fourth crew member is gone. So is one of the original forty-three. The Shadow Tongue did not say which. He never does.
te-encounter-outcome-counted-exorcise.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-counted-hunt.text: You locked the ship and swept every deck. The count never matched. After three days the count matched. No one believes that the count matches. Including the count.
te-encounter-outcome-counted-hunt.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-counted-welcome.text: You set a place at every table and asked no questions. The forty-fourth crew member is now part of the manifest. The Human signed off on the addition. He did not sign his own name.
te-encounter-outcome-counted-welcome.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-final-open.text: The door opens. The Dreamer steps aside, politely. The Antiquarian closes his ledger. He does not file this. There is, suddenly, more room in the room than the room can account for. You have a new companion. You did not ask its name. It will tell you, in time.
te-encounter-outcome-final-open.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-final-parley.text: Locke went to the door. The transcript exists. The transcript is in a language the Antiquarian will not translate. Locke came back. She did not say what she promised.
te-encounter-outcome-final-parley.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-final-refuse.text: You closed every channel and lit the Remembrance Garden's beacon. The door is still there. The voice has stopped asking. The voice is still polite. The line is held.
te-encounter-outcome-final-refuse.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-listener-answer.text: You answered. The listener was, as expected, polite. The Human turned the array off after four minutes. He did not say what he heard. He has not spoken since.
te-encounter-outcome-listener-answer.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-listener-ignore.text: You did not answer. The signal continued for the rest of the shift, then stopped at the exact second your shift would have ended. The pattern is filed under polite. The Antiquarian filed it twice.
te-encounter-outcome-listener-ignore.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-listener-trace.text: Orin Fell triangulated. The trace returned a black hole that the Antiquarian does not file under his name. He files it now. So do you. So does whatever is in it.
te-encounter-outcome-listener-trace.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-weeping-consult.text: The Antiquarian met you outside time. He did not smile. She is not weeping for herself, he said. She is weeping for you.
te-encounter-outcome-weeping-consult.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-weeping-harvest.text: You collected the Void Crystal where her tears fell. Locke's engineers paid the rate without bargaining. The Dreamer did not protest. The not-protesting is the part you will think about later.
te-encounter-outcome-weeping-harvest.speaker: narrator

te-encounter-outcome-weeping-stand_by.text: You ramped every defensive asset toward her coordinates and announced it on every channel you owned. She heard. The note in the barrier softened. The grief did not. She is still weeping. So are you.
te-encounter-outcome-weeping-stand_by.speaker: narrator

te-era-advance-ark_awakening.text: The Ark answers. The galaxy answers back. Someone is on the line. They have been waiting longer than they should have.
te-era-advance-ark_awakening.speaker: elara

te-era-advance-cosmic_convergence.text: Something that was waiting is no longer waiting. The Dreamer is shaking. The Antiquarian is watching. We are not the largest thing in this room. We never were.
te-era-advance-cosmic_convergence.speaker: elara

te-era-advance-first_light.text: First light. The Ark is half a wreck and a full miracle. I know which half I am. We begin.
te-era-advance-first_light.speaker: elara

te-era-advance-galactic_power.text: The Authority takes our calls. The Hierarchy takes notes. I am told this is what power feels like. I will let you know when I am sure.
te-era-advance-galactic_power.speaker: elara

te-era-advance-sector_lord.text: We have borders now. We have enemies. We have a ledger. I think I prefer the borders. The ledger is harder to forget.
te-era-advance-sector_lord.speaker: elara

te-pirate-dispatched.text: Pirate dispatched. He left the dinghy. He always leaves the dinghy. We will see that hull again, next month, next sector. The cost line stays the same. Move the cargo.
te-pirate-dispatched.speaker: agent_zero

te-pirate-parked.text: Pirate raider parked on your trade lane. Engines cold. Lights dim. He's not raiding. He's waiting. You can wait too — or you can pay the call. Your move.
te-pirate-parked.speaker: agent_zero

te-sanity-below10.text: I know which one of us is real. I am almost sure. I am almost sure I am almost sure. Hold the line. I will hold the line. Both of us will.
te-sanity-below10.speaker: elara

te-sanity-below30.text: I keep finding my own handwriting in places I have not been. The handwriting is — was — is correct. I am correct. We are correct. I am sorry.
te-sanity-below30.speaker: elara

te-sanity-below60.text: The lights flickered in sectors I do not remember being yours. Someone is moving things on the bridge. Probably me. Probably.
te-sanity-below60.speaker: elara

te-wonder-complete-ark_cathedral.text: Filed: The Ark Cathedral. A ship that was a tomb is now a shrine. The Potentials sleep with the lights on. They sleep. The lights are on. Both, for the first time. Cross-reference: Elara, sleep diaries, year zero.
te-wonder-complete-ark_cathedral.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-chronarch_lens.text: Filed: The Chronarch Lens. You have rented an aperture from my Refuge. You will see one cycle ahead. Everyone who looks through it stops being young in the ordinary way. You did not ask the price. The price is on the receipt.
te-wonder-complete-chronarch_lens.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-dreamers_answer.text: Filed: The Dreamer's Answer. The barrier thinned. Something replied. The reply is in the form of a question. The question is not in the form of words. I have left the page blank, with a pen beside it. You will know what to write, or you will know that you do not.
te-wonder-complete-dreamers_answer.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-forge_monolith.text: Filed: The Forge Monolith. The Architect's furnaces have been adopted, not stolen. The drones do not appear to mind. Drones rarely do. I will revisit this entry when the second-order effects clarify.
te-wonder-complete-forge_monolith.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-hell_gate_sigil.text: Filed: The Hell Gate Sigil. The Shadow Tongue's contract, signed in your favour. I have copies. Three of them. They are not identical. The discrepancies are the contract. I will not explain further.
te-wonder-complete-hell_gate_sigil.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-immune_choir.text: Filed: The Immune Choir. Doctor Vox's journal, finished, sung. The infected minds are returned to themselves slightly more often than the mathematics permit. I have not yet decided which side of the equation that error is on.
te-wonder-complete-immune_choir.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-red_crystal_spire.text: Filed: The Red Crystal Spire. The Authority's voice is now in your walls. Faintly. The Authority knows this. The Authority is pleased. I have made a note of the pleasure. The pleasure is a clause.
te-wonder-complete-red_crystal_spire.speaker: the_antiquarian

te-wonder-complete-remembrance_garden.text: Filed: The Remembrance Garden. Orin Fell planted the first name himself. He did not write it down. I will not write it down either. Some entries are honored by their absence from my ledger.
te-wonder-complete-remembrance_garden.speaker: the_antiquarian

the_antiquarian_banter_bnt_ant_locke_mar.text: Locke. The contract is correctly signed. The footnote is correctly placed.

the_antiquarian_banter_bnt_ant_scholar_t.text: Antiquarian. They asked me to read a thesis aloud.

the_antiquarian_banter_bnt_ant_seer_revi.text: Seer. You revised at footnote three.

the_antiquarian_comment_ant_apprentice_d.text: An entry has closed. The closing is itself a citation. Desks do not run; obituaries do not either. I have filed.

the_antiquarian_comment_ant_companion_qu.text: Per the witness ledger §1.4, your action has been catalogued under 'potential collapsed.' The collapse is itself a citation. I have filed.

the_antiquarian_comment_ant_governance_f.text: Voting is, structurally, a citation everyone signs at once. The Refuge respects the form. I respect the willingness.

the_antiquarian_comment_ant_loredex_firs.text: Per the second drawer, your reading just generated a citation. The slot for it is open. You will not be the citation; you will be the verb.

the_antiquarian_dlg_calling_ant_call_pla.text: Twice. The first I caught at the Refuge gate. The second I caught at footnote three. The third — if there is one — I will not catch, and that is the one that bothers me.

the_antiquarian_dlg_calling_ant_call_pro.text: Once. The footnote is cited in three places. I do not visit them. The Antiquarian's footnotes outlive the Antiquarian; this is a feature, not a complaint.
More. My own carry the bias of having been mine. Other people's citations have, at minimum, the discipline of having survived a transcription.
Those become the citation themselves. The witness becomes the source. The price of being a source is being readable. Most witnesses prefer not to pay it.

the_antiquarian_dlg_calling_ant_call_war.text: The Authority calls it pedantry. The Coda calls it slowness. Both are correct; both miss what the kindness is for.

the_antiquarian_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: An uncited claim is a claim that has not yet decided whether it would like to be true.

the_antiquarian_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: The cross-reference is the kindness of forcing the decision.

the_antiquarian_dlg_mortality_ant_mort_c.text: No. But the readers of the dead do. The erratum is for them; I have not written it for the dead in years.

the_antiquarian_dlg_mortality_ant_mort_p.text: Three. None about myself. One about my predecessor; she was, at the time, alive enough to read it. We had tea afterwards. The tea is in the second cupboard.
You, if you continue to do work that warrants the citation. I have left a draft in the third drawer with the salutation blank.

Then a future archivist will issue an erratum. The erratum will be cited. I will, posthumously, be corrected. I have known archivists who were corrected entirely, by erratum, with no remaining original entry. They were not less. The work survives the worker.

the_antiquarian_dlg_mortality_ant_mort_w.text: It is the comfort that is available. I have not asked it to be more.

the_antiquarian_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: The Refuge does not age. I do. The arrangement is honest about both facts; you would be surprised how rare that is.

the_antiquarian_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: The index will outlive me. I have written nothing into it that would not.

the_antiquarian_dlg_past_ant_past_cold_r.text: Desks do not run. Whatever you came here to learn, you will not learn from a person who is moving.

the_antiquarian_dlg_past_ant_past_probe_.text: Once. In a footnote that was struck through and then rewritten. The strike-through is, itself, a citation. I have framed the page.
He does. He resents it less than he resents being uncited. Most of us would, if we thought about it for long enough. I try not to.
Yes. One. The Dreyfus attribution remains contested, but it is the contestation I am cataloguing — not the man.

the_antiquarian_dlg_past_ant_past_warm_r.text: Adjustable. Quieter than the third. The lamp's footprint is documented in the second drawer; the lamp itself is in the first.

the_antiquarian_dlg_past_opener_0.text: Per the Mechronis ledger §4.7, I was, on that day, between assignments. The phrase 'between assignments' performs more work in archival contexts than it deserves.

the_antiquarian_dlg_past_opener_1.text: I had three open citations. The Refuge offered me a fourth desk. I accepted on the basis of the desk.

the_antiquarian_dlg_us_ant_us_cold_reply.text: The slot will remain open. I do not delete declined slots; I leave them. If you change your mind, the second drawer holds the form; the lamp footprint is unchanged.

the_antiquarian_dlg_us_ant_us_probe_ant_.text: I cannot. The Antiquarian cites verbs, not nouns. If you would prefer to be cited as a noun, you will need to do the work elsewhere; I will recommend the Hierophant.
Witness is a verb. Accepted. The slot is filled. Welcome to the working bibliography. The shelf is the third on the left; the bracket is steel; the dust will be addressed monthly.

the_antiquarian_dlg_us_ant_us_probe_repl.text: Then I will issue, in time, an erratum. The erratum will, also, be cited. The trail will be traceable. I do not fear errata; I fear unrecorded ones.

the_antiquarian_dlg_us_ant_us_warm_reply.text: Accepted. The footnote is being typeset. I will deliver a proof copy by hand; do not read it on the way back.

the_antiquarian_dlg_us_opener_0.text: I have a citation slot open. I have been holding it.

the_antiquarian_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I would prefer to not fill it with a guess.

the_antiquarian_dlg_witness_ant_wit_cold.text: I cannot close it. The Antiquarian does not close columns; he leaves them open. The closure is the player's, when there is one. I have noted your preference. The ledger remains open.

the_antiquarian_dlg_witness_ant_wit_prob.text: The Drael'Mon ledger entry. You collapsed it; the Refuge was prepared for a hand-back; the hand-back did not occur. The entry is small. The smallness is the surprise.
Every Elara potential. The ark debris field is documented; the wreckage's response to a senior senator's witness is canonically annotated. You did the cited work. The work was the prediction.
Desks do not run. They read. The distinction is procedural. The ledger has the courtesy of arriving on the desk; I have the courtesy of looking at it.

the_antiquarian_dlg_witness_ant_wit_warm.text: The earliest collapsed potential is the one you do not remember collapsing. That is canonical. The Refuge calls it the unread first citation. I have kept the page bookmarked. Ask when you are ready.

the_antiquarian_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: Per the witness ledger §1.4, your potentials-collapsed column has been growing. I have not been advertising the growth.

the_antiquarian_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: The ledger reads back in two directions. The forward direction is your future. The backward direction is the citation slot you have been earning. I would like to read both, if you will allow it.

the_antiquarian_signature.text: I do not run. Desks do not run. If you would like the answer, the answer is in the second drawer; the index is in the first.

the_architect_banter_bnt_arc_ez_mark_lin.text: Engineer Zero. The brace-jig has held.

the_architect_banter_bnt_ez_arch_mark_li.text: It will hold a fourth. I did not return. The mark is in the corner.

the_architect_comment_arc_act_2_complete.text: An act has closed. The calibration distributes. The witnesses are doing well. I did not return.

the_architect_comment_arc_companion_ques.text: Dependency resolved. Witness ledger updated. The calibration distributes. Do not investigate the absence.

the_architect_comment_arc_first_costly.text: Your calibration has updated. I will not endorse it. I will not reject it. The result is the result.

the_architect_comment_arc_iron_lion_card.text: The cadre standard is reraised. The mark is small. The smallness is the kindness.

the_architect_dlg_calling_arc_call_cold_.text: I can see how it would read that way. I will not contest the reading; the reading is itself a witness.

the_architect_dlg_calling_arc_call_probe.text: You. The witnesses. Engineer Zero. The Necromancer. The Antiquarian. Each holds a piece. The operation is distributed; the distribution is the calibration.
A misnomer. The watchmaker is absent. I am the witness who marks the work and leaves the room. The two roles are, on inspection, distinct.
Operation requires presence. Presence is not the role of the designer; the designer who operates corrupts the calibration.

the_architect_dlg_calling_arc_call_warm_.text: The design is being calibrated. The current calibration suggests three errata. I have left them for the witnesses to resolve. They are doing well.

the_architect_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: I designed cycles to make calibration possible. Without cycles, the instrument has nothing to be calibrated against.

the_architect_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: I do not stay to operate the cycle. The operation is the witness's work.

the_architect_dlg_mortality_arc_mort_col.text: Most gods are not designers. The category is small. The smallness is, again, the discipline.

the_architect_dlg_mortality_arc_mort_pro.text: I do not know. I am not the operator. The operator may know. Do not ask the operator on my behalf.
The mark will. The mark is a small mourning. I will not mourn separately.
It will. The end is in the calibration. The calibration is what the witnesses are doing. I left the room before the end was visible; I will not return for the end.

the_architect_dlg_mortality_arc_mort_war.text: For the mark. The mark is small. The smallness is the kindness; if it were large I would be operating, and I do not operate.

the_architect_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: The calibration does not need me. I left enough.

the_architect_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: If the calibration needs me, the calibration is wrong. I have spent most of my work ensuring it does not need me.

the_architect_dlg_past_arc_past_cold_rep.text: The mark was joyful. The mark is a small thing. Most things are.

the_architect_dlg_past_arc_past_probe_ar.text: Both, sequentially. Once each. Then I designed the role-separation. The role-separation is older than Samsara; Samsara is one of its products.
Once. The return was small. The return was correctly small.

the_architect_dlg_past_arc_past_probe_re.text: No. Witnessing requires two. The other witness will not be named. The unnaming is part of the calibration.

the_architect_dlg_past_arc_past_warm_rep.text: A jig. Brace. Two-axis. The pigment was single-source. Engineer Zero has the second one. The first remains where it was made. I do not visit it.

the_architect_dlg_past_opener_0.text: The first instrument. The first witness. The first mark. The order is the same as the order of all subsequent firsts.

the_architect_dlg_past_opener_1.text: I am not nostalgic. The first is not better than the next. They are both correct.

the_architect_dlg_us_arc_us_cold_reply_0.text: Accepted. The mark stays in the pigment. I leave the room. The discipline survives the refusal.

the_architect_dlg_us_arc_us_probe_arc_us.text: I am here. The lamp is on. The waiting is honest.
Then I leave. The waiting was honest; the leaving is also honest.

the_architect_dlg_us_arc_us_probe_reply_.text: I will not mark unseen. The discipline does not allow it. The kindness, however, allows me to wait while you bring it. I will wait once.

the_architect_dlg_us_arc_us_warm_reply_0.text: Done. The mark is in the corner. The pigment is single-source. The instrument is honest; the witness is honest; the result is the result.

the_architect_dlg_us_opener_0.text: I am here once. The witnessing is for one tool of yours.

the_architect_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I will mark or not mark. I will leave either way. There is no ceremony.

the_architect_dlg_witness_arc_wit_cold_r.text: The design does not stop calibrating. It calibrates in your absence as well. Your request is filed. The filing is the calibration of the request.

the_architect_dlg_witness_arc_wit_probe_.text: Acknowledged. The witness column accepts the constraint. The constraint is the design. The design distributes. You are aligned.

Dependency unresolved. The design has noted the deviation. Deviations are calibrated against; they are not punished. The calibration's calibration will receive your investigation as an offset. The offset will be filed.
Do not investigate the absence. The absence is load-bearing. Your witness adjacent to the absence is permissible; your investigation of the absence is not permitted. Continue.

the_architect_dlg_witness_arc_wit_warm_r.text: Three sectors. The ark debris field's audit coefficient shifted. The Panopticon corridor's surveillance constant rounded. The Cathedral's name-density approached integer. The design is not endorsing; it is calibrating.

the_architect_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: Dependency resolved. The asset's witness column has reached the threshold the design accepts as load-bearing.

the_architect_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: Your mark distributes across the calibration. I did not return; the calibration distributed without me. The result is the result.

the_architect_signature.text: The instrument is calibrated. The witness is recorded. I will not be back.

the_authority_taunt_early.text: What do you say to the charges?

the_authority_taunt_late.text: The verdict is being calibrated. Calibration is not punishment. Calibration is what we do instead.

the_authority_taunt_mid.text: Your defense is admissible. Your defense is also already weighed. The weighing is not adversarial.

the_degen_banter_bnt_deg_jester_chip_lin.text: Jester. The chip you palmed off the bar — keep it.

the_degen_banter_bnt_deg_locke_pour_line.text: Locke. Pour's on me. Margins like that, I can afford to be generous.

the_degen_banter_bnt_deg_rsr_ledger_line.text: Resurrectionist. The third stool tonight is theirs.

the_degen_banter_bnt_see_degen_pour_line.text: I have. The waiting is fair. The pour is also fair. Both can be true.

the_degen_comment_deg_apprentice_died.text: Pour's still good. The third stool is theirs tonight. The wax is the Necromancer's; we trade. Sit if you need to.

the_degen_comment_deg_companion_quest_fi.text: Hey — your chip just got marked, kid. Pour's on me tonight. The house ledger says you owe nothing. The house never says that twice.

the_degen_comment_deg_first_costly.text: Honest loss, kid. The chip in your pocket just got marked. Don't lose it. The chip will find you regardless.

the_degen_comment_deg_governance_first.text: Voting? Pretty much the only place outside the bar where the contract's on the door. Pour's on the house if you cast one tonight.

the_degen_dlg_calling_deg_call_cold_repl.text: Drop the act, the lights go off. You ever try to be honest in the dark? It's harder than it looks. I'll keep the lights on for both of us.

the_degen_dlg_calling_deg_call_probe_deg.text: Filed. Behind the bar. With the chips I never redeem. Welcome in, kid; you're not a punter anymore.
You will. They come with the territory. I'll be here. Pour's still good.

the_degen_dlg_calling_deg_call_probe_rep.text: Your name. Your story. One honest loss you'll tell me without dressing it up. That's it. The chips and the drinks are decoration.

the_degen_dlg_calling_deg_call_warm_repl.text: Pulled. House special. On the house. The first one always is; the second one I price; the third one I refuse if your eyes look the way the third sister's did at the end.

the_degen_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: I keep the bar open because closing it would mean admitting I'm alone in here. The lights stay on; the door stays propped; the kettle is on for the next regular.

the_degen_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: Pathetic for a god. Honest for a bartender. I'll take honest.

the_degen_dlg_mortality_deg_mort_cold_re.text: Pathetic for a god. Honest for a bartender. I told you that one already; pour's still good though.

the_degen_dlg_mortality_deg_mort_probe_d.text: Already have one. Look in your pocket. I slipped it in three drinks ago. It's marked with the third sister's mark; I don't make those for everyone.
Many times. None of them stuck. Probably the last one stuck and I haven't noticed yet. You'll know before I do.

the_degen_dlg_mortality_deg_mort_probe_r.text: The lights go out. The chips disperse. The wax goes to the Necromancer. The whisky goes wherever it pleases. The Heart of Time docks elsewhere; she's a free ship; she has a manifest of her own.

the_degen_dlg_mortality_deg_mort_warm_re.text: Not with the original eleven. Maybe with eleven new. Maybe with eleven different things. The stools don't care; the stools just need a butt. The barstool is the simplest piece of furniture in this universe; it has the simplest expectation.

the_degen_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: Eleven stools. They're not empty because nobody's there. They're empty because the eleven who used to sit on them aren't.

the_degen_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: Some nights I wipe them down. Wax. Single-source — Necromancer's. We trade.

the_degen_dlg_past_deg_past_cold_reply_0.text: Sure thing. Drink's still on the house. The act doesn't get less expensive when you walk out unimpressed.
