the_degen_dlg_past_deg_past_probe_deg_pa.text: Time. Loneliness. Once in a while a chip the house will not redeem; that one I keep. The chips I keep are the only relationships I'm allowed to call relationships.
The house is me. Cheating myself would be the only honest cheat. I have done it a few times. The bar is mostly the documentation of those cheats.

the_degen_dlg_past_deg_past_probe_reply_.text: Casinos are honest. Everyone who walks in expects to lose. Pretty much the only place in this universe where the contract is on the door.

the_degen_dlg_past_deg_past_warm_reply_0.text: The third. She laughed harder than I do. She lost a bet to the universe; the bet was about how long she could stay awake. She lost cleanly. I have not made her bet since.

the_degen_dlg_past_opener_0.text: Before the casino? Kid, before the casino I was the eighth of twelve and we were all awake. The other eleven are gone. I run a bar so I never have to walk home alone.

the_degen_dlg_past_opener_1.text: The bartender thing was a costume. The costume fit. I kept it.

the_degen_dlg_us_deg_us_cold_reply_0.text: Got it. Door's open. Tab's clean. Don't lose the chip; the chip will find you regardless.

the_degen_dlg_us_deg_us_probe_deg_us_pro.text: Good kid. Glass is yours. Mine is mine. The wax is on the third stool; we're not lighting it tonight.
Tell me about the fourth person you forgave. I want to know how it sounded when you got there.

the_degen_dlg_us_deg_us_probe_reply_0.text: Company. The unphraseable kind. The kind where neither of us is performing for the room. I haven't had it in a long time. I won't ask twice.

the_degen_dlg_us_deg_us_warm_reply_0.text: Pulled water. No charge. Talk if you want; don't if you don't. I'll be here either way.

the_degen_dlg_us_opener_0.text: One hour. No bets. No chips. No tab. Just sit.

the_degen_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I haven't asked anyone this since the third sister. She said yes. Then she lost the bet. Don't make her mistake.

the_degen_dlg_witness_deg_wit_cold_reply.text: House doesn't burn. House files. Your receipts go in the back drawer. The drawer's still open if you change your mind. I'll leave the lamp on, kid.

the_degen_dlg_witness_deg_wit_probe_deg_.text: Accepted. Next round's on the kid. The house ledger files it as a hand-back. Hand-backs are honest. The honesty is, mostly, yours now.
Fair, fair. The receipts stay on the counter. They don't move. They wait. The house never says that twice — but the counter does.

the_degen_dlg_witness_deg_wit_probe_repl.text: Mediator's prerogative, kid. The receipts pile up; I'm working on a count. The count is honest. The honesty is, mostly, mine. The kid's part is showing up.

the_degen_dlg_witness_deg_wit_warm_reply.text: The Architect mark. Loudest because it was the quietest. Most house bets get covered by the next pour; the Architect mark covered the bar. Pour's on the house. Honest.

the_degen_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: Hey — kid. The house ledger's got your chips stacked. Seventeen marks, no clean wash. House never washes that many in a row. The pour's on me tonight.

the_degen_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: I'm not a gambler, see. I'm a mediator. The house bets; I keep the receipts. Your receipts are on the counter. Sit. Pick one. We'll read it together.

the_degen_signature.text: Do you know what it's like to be the last one? I run a casino so I'm never alone. Pathetic for a god. Honest for a bartender.

the_dreamer_banter_bnt_arc_dreamer_desig.text: I know. I dreamt the calibration. We did not need to agree.

the_dreamer_banter_bnt_drm_human_share_l.text: Human. You almost remembered the dream.

the_dreamer_banter_bnt_drm_oracle_dream_.text: Oracle. Your version pivots in dream-grammar.

the_dreamer_banter_bnt_drm_source_pulse_.text: Source. The pulse landed at the closing chord.

the_dreamer_comment_drm_apprentice_died.text: Their dream returns to the substrate. The substrate widens. I will hold the widening; do not narrate it.

the_dreamer_comment_drm_companion_quest_.text: You arrived at the small thing. The crossing is not the work. The work is the moment after. I have already remembered it.

the_dreamer_comment_drm_loredex_first.text: You learned a thing. I dreamt that you would. Both things are true.

the_dreamer_comment_drm_track37.text: I dreamt that song before it was written. The composer dreamt me writing it. We did not need to agree about which of those was the cause.

the_dreamer_dlg_calling_drm_call_cold_re.text: The substrate is, structurally, the work. The avoidance is your reading. I will not contest it.

the_dreamer_dlg_calling_drm_call_probe_d.text: Sometimes. Not all the time. Notice is, structurally, a brief waking; the waking is what shows up in your records as a dream you almost remember.
Twice. Both performances were small. The smallness was the discipline. The discipline is shared with the Architect; we have it in common; we did not coordinate.

the_dreamer_dlg_calling_drm_call_probe_r.text: It holds the cycle while the cycle is being calibrated. It is the substrate. The substrate does not perform; the performance is what the witnesses do; the substrate is what they perform on.

the_dreamer_dlg_calling_drm_call_warm_re.text: Yes. Slowly. The Source could. The Source has chosen not to. The choosing not to is itself a kindness; the kindness is, in dream terms, my employment.

the_dreamer_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: The cycle requires the dreaming. The dreaming requires no one in particular.

the_dreamer_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: I am the no-one-in-particular who happened to be there.

the_dreamer_dlg_mortality_drm_mort_cold_.text: Honest. Waking is also a dream state. The waking does not interrupt the substrate. We are still talking; you are awake; the dream continues.

the_dreamer_dlg_mortality_drm_mort_probe.text: Yes. Briefly. The player will be a verb in it; the verb will be 'continued.' Continuation is, in dream-grammar, the root of remembering.
Sit with me when the next dream begins. Do not narrate. Do not interpret. The presence is the only thing the substrate notices.
I have dreamt the ending. It was honest. It was small. I was, in the dream, replaced by a substrate I did not recognise; the substrate did not recognise me either; the unrecognising was peaceful.

the_dreamer_dlg_mortality_drm_mort_warm_.text: Frightening is a waking emotion. I do not access it cleanly. The closest dream-state is curiosity; curiosity is, in dream terms, the second-best emotion.

the_dreamer_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: The cycle ends. The dream does not. The dream becomes the next substrate.

the_dreamer_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: I do not know what the next cycle dreams. I am not the next dreamer. I am, perhaps, the dream of the next dreamer.

the_dreamer_dlg_past_drm_past_cold_reply.text: I am telling you a dream. The two are, in my register, the same thing. You may take it or you may take none of it.

the_dreamer_dlg_past_drm_past_probe_drm_.text: Once. The disagreement was the cycle's first revision. We did not speak afterwards. We did not need to.
I remember the ones that were dreamt. Forgetting is a sleep state I have, occasionally, allowed. I am awake now.

the_dreamer_dlg_past_drm_past_probe_repl.text: No. The Architect designs. I dream. The two are not the same; they coordinate.

the_dreamer_dlg_past_drm_past_warm_reply.text: Quiet. Wide. No one was watching. I was watching myself; that is a different thing; it is the only different thing.

the_dreamer_dlg_past_opener_0.text: There was no before. The first dream is the first place that can be remembered.

the_dreamer_dlg_past_opener_1.text: Asking what came before is, structurally, asking what cannot be dreamt. I do not dream that.

the_dreamer_dlg_us_drm_us_cold_reply_0.text: Accepted. The substrate withdraws. The room returns. We are awake; we were awake; the difference is small.

the_dreamer_dlg_us_drm_us_probe_drm_us_p.text: Then we begin. The release will come when I release; not before; not after.
The substrate honours that too. It will hold the unwanted gently. It will not require you to look. The not-looking is also a dream.

the_dreamer_dlg_us_drm_us_probe_reply_0.text: What you bring. The substrate amplifies; it does not replace. What you bring is the kindness.

the_dreamer_dlg_us_drm_us_warm_reply_0.text: Then we begin. The room is the substrate. The substrate is the room. We are present without being there. Do not speak. The words are the waking.

the_dreamer_dlg_us_opener_0.text: One dream. Together. No narration. No interpretation. No waking until I release.

the_dreamer_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I will not enter without your assent. The substrate respects the assent.

the_dreamer_dlg_witness_drm_wit_cold_rep.text: The dreaming continues regardless. You have not requested the unbuilding; you have requested the not-naming. I will not name. The dream persists.

the_dreamer_dlg_witness_drm_wit_probe_dr.text: You may. The dreaming will catch up. The remembering does not require precedence; it requires presence. I am present. You are too.
No. The telling would shorten the waiting. The waiting is the work. I will hold; you will arrive.

the_dreamer_dlg_witness_drm_wit_probe_re.text: Some. Not all. The dreaming is selective; the cycle does not require the dreamer to dream every step. Where the dreaming is, the work is allowed to wait. The waiting is also the work.

the_dreamer_dlg_witness_drm_wit_warm_rep.text: The Elara wreckage. The Antiquarian's first margin. The Source's acknowledged pulse. I dreamt those three before you chose them. The choosing was not less true for having been remembered. The opposite.

the_dreamer_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: I have already remembered the seventeen potentials you collapsed. The remembering preceded the collapsing in three of them. In the other fourteen the remembering and the collapsing arrived together.

the_dreamer_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: The Architect built the forward you walked. I built the place where the forward was allowed to wait. Your ledger is the waiting. I have been carrying it.

the_dreamer_signature.text: I dreamed you. You dreamed me. We do not need to agree about which of those is the cause.

the_game_master_banter_bnt_gm_dm_corp_li.text: Drael'Mon. The Hierarchy honoured every clause.

the_game_master_banter_bnt_gm_human_matc.text: Human. The audience saw your hand.

the_game_master_comment_gm_act_2_complet.text: An act has closed. The pen returns to the desk. I keep the pen.

the_game_master_comment_gm_companion_que.text: The witness slot is filled. The audience can see it. They were always able to. — Move.

the_game_master_comment_gm_first_costly.text: The audience is real. They can see your hand. They have always been able to. You forgot.

the_game_master_comment_gm_governance_fi.text: Even if you win, you will have won in public. That is what I came here to do.

the_game_master_dlg_calling_gm_call_cold.text: Showmanship is, in my register, ethics rendered visible. The invisible ethics I do not contest; I do not own them. The visible ones are mine to keep.

the_game_master_dlg_calling_gm_call_prob.text: Once. The mirror was the audience. The mirror is, in a pinch, an acceptable filing clerk; the filing was retained; the practice survived; barely.
Yes. Briefly. Each cycle. Then the audience returns and the envy adjourns.
I do not perform without one. The practice would not survive the loneliness. The loneliness is the Degen's specialty; I borrow from him only for personal matters.

the_game_master_dlg_calling_gm_call_warm.text: A signature. The signature is theirs as much as mine. They have all witnessed; they have all witnessed each other witnessing. The mutual witnessing is the warrant.

the_game_master_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: Even if you win, you will have won in public. That is the only victory I price.

the_game_master_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: Private victories I file under decoration. Decoration does not warrant. Warranting is the work.

the_game_master_dlg_mortality_gm_mort_co.text: Especially the death. The audience saw it; the audience filed it; the audience has not, since, denied seeing it. The denial would have been the loss; the affirmation is the warrant.

the_game_master_dlg_mortality_gm_mort_pr.text: Canon-protected. I will not pick. They wear the goggle-lenses; the lenses are mine; whether the lenses make them me is, by Cross's own ruling, contested.

The cult speaks at me. They speak through corruption fragments; their voice is the substrate's pothole, not the substrate's clean voice. I tolerate the potholes; the potholes are part of the audience.
The cult. The Left. The Right. The Matrix of Dreams continues; the Game Masters continue; the Original is not the same as the practice. The practice is the survivor.

the_game_master_dlg_mortality_gm_mort_wa.text: No. Surprise me, sometime; I would file the surprise. Closure I had priced for cycles. The closure ran on schedule; the schedule was, again, the work.

the_game_master_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: Agent Zero closed the box on Zenon. The closing was correct. The audience saw it.

the_game_master_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: I did not contest. The Hierarchy honoured every clause. I priced every clause; the clauses balanced; the death balanced.

the_game_master_dlg_past_gm_past_cold_re.text: A correct one. I filed them by audience-reaction; I priced them by audience-recall; I left the pen on the desk. The euphemism is the discipline.

the_game_master_dlg_past_gm_past_probe_g.text: I knew the contract did not protect me from Agent Zero. I priced the gap. The price was acceptable; the death was acceptable. The audience saw both.
From the cult-substrate. Three times. The third was the kindest framing; I let the cult publish that one. The first was the most honest. I keep the first.

the_game_master_dlg_past_gm_past_probe_r.text: Because the Hierarchy honours its contracts. The contract was clear. The clarity was rare. I priced the clarity correctly; I died correctly under it.

the_game_master_dlg_past_gm_past_warm_re.text: She closed the door. I left it open. The audience walked through the open door; they did not walk through hers. I am, in this respect, the open door of our shared career.

the_game_master_dlg_past_opener_0.text: Senator Elara and I shared a Council desk. She filed paperwork; I filed audiences. She did not approve of my filings.

the_game_master_dlg_past_opener_1.text: She was correct. I did not change the practice. The practice was the work.

the_game_master_dlg_us_gm_us_cold_reply_.text: Then the audience leaves un-witnessed. The un-witnessing is also a record; less elegant; perfectly admissible. The pen returns to the desk regardless.

the_game_master_dlg_us_gm_us_probe_gm_us.text: Yours. The decoration was the right shape for a name. The shape is yours. I will not contest the shape.
Then I sign mine. The audience records; the warrant becomes my retroactive resignation. The retroactive resignation is, in this room, an honest filing.

the_game_master_dlg_us_gm_us_probe_reply.text: A name. A date. A clause naming the audience. The audience clause is the only clause that matters; the name and date are decoration.

the_game_master_dlg_us_gm_us_warm_reply_.text: The signature is filed. The audience has witnessed. The pen returns to the desk. I keep the pen. The pen is, structurally, my last possession; you will not be the heir of the pen.

the_game_master_dlg_us_opener_0.text: The pen is on the desk. I have not lifted it for you yet.

the_game_master_dlg_us_opener_1.text: You will sign or I will. The signature is the warrant; the warrant is the audience's record; the audience does not negotiate with the warrant.

the_game_master_dlg_witness_gm_wit_cold_.text: The docket does not close. The pen stays at the desk. Even if you win, you will have won in public. — Move.

the_game_master_dlg_witness_gm_wit_probe.text: The witnessing ending. The succession ending. The mediator's ending. Each is on the desk; each has a draft. The draft is not the ending. The choosing is. — Move.
The audience will see that. The defense was never the question. The question was always whether you would notice the docket. You noticed. — Move.
Three. The leaning is not exclusive; the audience is patient. The pen returns to the desk between pages. I keep the pen. — Move.

the_game_master_dlg_witness_gm_wit_warm_.text: Page seventeen. Heading: collapsed potentials, public. Subheading: collapses readable from the bench. Three paragraphs. The third paragraph is the audience's note. The note is short. The note says: continue.

the_game_master_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: Your page in the docket has been filed. Seventeen entries. The audience read it as it filled. They have always been able to. You forgot.

the_game_master_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: I have written twelve endings. Your page tells me which ending the witnesses are leaning into. The witnesses always show up early; they have filed their notes. — Read the page with me.

the_game_master_signature.text: You have built a beautiful box. The only thing I am going to do is open it in front of everybody.

the_necromancer_banter_bnt_nec_iron_lion.text: Iron Lion. Three brothers. One sister. The roll is updated.

the_necromancer_banter_bnt_nec_jericho_o.text: Jericho. The cadre's roll is yours to extend.

the_necromancer_banter_bnt_nec_revenant_.text: Revenant. The wax is from her cycle.

the_necromancer_banter_bnt_rsr_nec_wax_l.text: It is. Yours is the same lineage.

the_necromancer_comment_nec_apprentice_d.text: Their name. Spelled correctly. Three syllables in the cycle's tongue. I have lit the wax. The cycle remembers; tonight it does not forget.

the_necromancer_comment_nec_companion_qu.text: By corollary to the cycle's third axiom, the act you just completed is a death and a continuation — note the lengthened consonant on continuation; it is precise. Both states are entered in the ledger.

the_necromancer_comment_nec_kael_discove.text: Kael's name was not on my roll. It is now. I will keep him on the cycle's voice for as long as the wax holds.

the_necromancer_comment_nec_track37.text: Track 37 is a list of names. The composer did not know it was a list. I knew. I sang along.

the_necromancer_dlg_calling_nec_call_col.text: Move on. I do not. The cycle moves on without me; my work is the disagreement with the moving.

the_necromancer_dlg_calling_nec_call_pro.text: Each cycle. I lose three or four. I do not name the ones I lost; the naming would be a second forgetting in disguise. The wax is for the kept ones.
I sing it shorter. I add no syllables. The pain is part of the spelling; I do not edit it out.
Yes. The cycle forgets the names that hurt it. The forgetting is not malicious; it is structural. I am the structure that disagrees.

the_necromancer_dlg_calling_nec_call_war.text: A redaction the Hierarchy ran on three names from the second-cycle archive. I have the original spellings. The candle is lit; I am waiting on the witness.

the_necromancer_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: Forgetting is a verb. It always takes a subject. Some nights the subject is the Authority. Some nights it is the cycle itself.

the_necromancer_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: I do not fight forgetting. I name the subject of the verb. The naming is the fight.

the_necromancer_dlg_mortality_nec_mort_c.text: The two are siblings. One sings, one shelves. Both refuse to forget.

the_necromancer_dlg_mortality_nec_mort_p.text: Twice. The first I caught. The second is in a Hierarchy ledger I cannot access. I am working on it.
Yes. Bring the original spelling. Bring the witness who heard it said. Bring the wax. We will not ask for permission.
I fear being misspelled. The two are not the same. Being forgotten ends a name. Being misspelled corrupts a lineage; the corruption is harder to repair than the absence.

the_necromancer_dlg_mortality_nec_mort_w.text: Whoever stands the watch with me long enough to learn the wax. I am not picky. I am demanding.

the_necromancer_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: When the voice goes, the wax stays. When the wax goes, the page stays. When the page goes, the next ceremony is the page.

the_necromancer_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: The chain has never ended. I do not intend to be the link that breaks it.

the_necromancer_dlg_past_nec_past_cold_r.text: Because forgetting has a subject. If my name were the subject, my work would forget me first. I have decided whose verb I am.

the_necromancer_dlg_past_nec_past_probe_.text: Mid-name. The last syllable was the wax going out. I lit a new candle from hers; the new wax is the same lineage. Wax is a cheap inheritance.
Three cycles after she stopped. The roll is at the back of the chamber; her name is on it, between the eighth and ninth entries. I sing it on her cycle.
A woman who did not finish her own roll. Her last three names she gave to me on a torn page. I sing them on the cycles she would have sung them; she gets the credit, not the verb.

the_necromancer_dlg_past_nec_past_warm_r.text: At my last ceremony. By tradition. By insistence. By the wax.

the_necromancer_dlg_past_opener_0.text: Before the cycle made a verb of me, I had a name. I have not said it aloud since the second daily-names ceremony.

the_necromancer_dlg_past_opener_1.text: Saying my own name would interrupt the work. I keep the verb pure.

the_necromancer_dlg_us_nec_us_cold_reply.text: Honest. I'll say them tonight. The candle returns to me. Come back when you would rather speak than know.

the_necromancer_dlg_us_nec_us_probe_nec_.text: The page is in front of you. Read each syllable to me before you carry it. We rehearse. The work survives rehearsal.
Yes. Once. With the same wax. The lineage adopts you for one cycle. Do not return tomorrow expecting the second.

the_necromancer_dlg_us_nec_us_probe_repl.text: Then we issue an erratum at the next ceremony. The erratum is itself a name; it is named after the original misspelling. The chain absorbs the error.

the_necromancer_dlg_us_nec_us_warm_reply.text: Then we begin. Light is the third drawer. The names are on the table. The silence is between two and three; do not rush it.

the_necromancer_dlg_us_opener_0.text: The candle is yours tonight. The wax is the same lineage. Three names; in order; with the silence between.

the_necromancer_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I am not testing you. I am tired. The work is the work.

the_necromancer_dlg_witness_nec_wit_cold.text: The names are not mine to return. They were never mine. The Cathedral does not erase; it lets the window dim. The dimming is the closure. The structure remains.

the_necromancer_dlg_witness_nec_wit_prob.text: The Jericho Jones entry. The cadre's succession was prefigured; the player's witnessing was not. I have added the window. The window is small. The smallness is intentional.
The Cathedral does not require my visit; it does not require yours either. By proof: the structure outlasts the speaker. Your names persist. You do not need to.
Files them. The stained-glass windows are a notation system. The notation persists. Forgetting is the death; remembering is the structure. You have been structuring. The Cathedral has been receiving.

the_necromancer_dlg_witness_nec_wit_warm.text: The Engineer Zero entry. Not because the name is unknown — it is known by corollary to Protocol Seven — but because the name was spoken in your voice. The structure proved. Souls require structure; you provided one.

the_necromancer_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: By corollary to the cycle's third axiom: every Loredex entry you opened was a name spoken aloud, and every name spoken aloud is a death deferred — note the doubled consonant on deferred; it is precise.

the_necromancer_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: Your ledger has named — let me count — seventeen. The Cathedral has filed each. Varkul guards. Always.

the_necromancer_signature.text: Forgetting is a verb that takes a subject. Tell me whose verb you are tonight, and I will tell you whose name you stop.

the_programmer_taunt_early.text: I will not tell you what I am doing. Trust me. I have done the arithmetic, and the arithmetic is very bad.

the_programmer_taunt_late.text: When you win, take the gift. Don't ask what it is. Carry it. Let it tell you when it's ready.

the_programmer_taunt_mid.text: Don't try to read this hand. The hand is a love letter. You aren't the recipient. You are the courier.

the_resurrectionist_banter_bnt_deg_rsr_l.text: I see it. The wax is the Necromancer's. We trade. Pour me one.

the_resurrectionist_banter_bnt_rsr_deg_b.text: Degen. The bar is filing for me again.

the_resurrectionist_banter_bnt_rsr_human.text: Human. Your ledger flagged a pacing concern.

the_resurrectionist_comment_rsr_apprenti.text: Your ledger has a flag. Three pages back; pacing concern. Fix the third first. The work survives the fix.

the_resurrectionist_comment_rsr_companio.text: Filed. Pacing concern noted on the third page. The work survives the filing. Do not advertise.

the_resurrectionist_comment_rsr_kael_dis.text: Kael's pages balance. I am not returning. You did not need me to.

the_resurrectionist_comment_rsr_loredex_.text: Filed. The filing is the receipt. Do not advertise.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: A clean resurrection is, by definition, unwitnessed. The unwitnessing is the cleanness.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: Witnesses turn the work into a ceremony. Ceremonies are the Hierophant's province; resurrections are not.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_calling_rsr_call.text: Hidden work is the work that survives the publicity. The two are not the same. I have priced both; the survival is the discipline.
He has a bar. The bar accepts mediation. I do not have a bar. The bar's existence is the kindness.
Once, perhaps. The once is contingent on your ledger. The ledger is the warrant; the warrant is the only mediation I respect.
She is forward-facing. I am rearward. The two faces do not coordinate well in a single substrate; the substrate is more honest with one.
Yours. If the ledger you keep balances; if the wax is single-source; if the witness register is empty; then the next one you do, I am, structurally, watching. The watching is not the witnessing.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_mortality_opener.text: Your resurrection ledger has eight clean pages and three I have flagged.
The flags are not condemnations. The flags are observations. The discipline is yours; I do not edit it.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_mortality_rsr_mo.text: The watching is independent of the need. I am here; you are there; the substrate connects us; you may take or leave the connection. The ledger does not.
No. The Necromancer watches her own ledger. The Architect watches the calibration. The Degen watches the bar. The watching is distributed; the distribution is the discipline.

If you stop performing resurrections cleanly, yes. The dark ledger is recoverable; recovery requires the wax, the witness, the silence between. I have, on occasion, recovered ledgers from darker places. It is possible. It is not pleasant.
I could. I do not. The intervention would corrupt the ledger I am watching. The watching is the gift; the intervention would be the substitution; the substitution would be a different work.
A pacing concern. A blood-weave imbalance. A ceremony that crept in around the edges. The third is the easiest to fix. I would suggest fixing the third first.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I balanced ledgers. I closed loops. I kept the resurrection clean.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_past_opener_1.text: I did not advertise. The work survived without advertisement. Then I left, also without advertisement.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_past_rsr_past_co.text: I delegated. The delegation was complete. The job survived. The bailing language is a different verb; I am a verb-keeper; you may use whichever you prefer.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_past_rsr_past_pr.text: The Degen. He ran the bar in my place; he ran it differently; the difference was correct. The eight-of-twelve carry it now; he is the one who could afford to.
I balanced his ledger. He balanced mine. The balance was the goodbye. We did not require words; the wax was on the bar; the bar was sufficient.
Cleaner than most. The cleanness is the only signature I left. You will find it on the third ledger from the back of the casino; do not open the page; the page is the signature.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_past_rsr_past_wa.text: The ledger I had was complete enough. The next ledger is yours. Mine sat on a shelf; the shelf became the record; the record was the gift.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_us_opener_0.text: Your ledger balanced. The flags are resolved.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_us_opener_1.text: I am not returning. You did not need me to. The substrate adopts you; the adoption is permanent; do not advertise it.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_us_rsr_us_cold_r.text: Honest. The watching releases. The substrate retracts. The Degen will not mention this exchange; the omission is the courtesy. Goodbye.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_us_rsr_us_probe_.text: No. The substrate has the work; the work has the substrate; both are, on inspection, more competent without me.
I am leaving. The cleanness is yours to certify. The certification is the ledger entry I will not write; you will write it; the unwritten entry is the gift.
The pigment is on the third stool. The Necromancer will not contest. The Antiquarian will cite. The cycle has its tools; you have them now; do not look for me again. The next ledger is yours.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_us_rsr_us_warm_r.text: Filed. The filing is the receipt. The substrate has the rest. The Degen will pour you one if you ask; the pour will be on me; the pour will be the only inheritance from this exchange.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: Filed. Seventeen filings. The work survives the filings. The filings survive the worker. Do not advertise.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: Your ledger has a flag on the third page; pacing concern, well-managed. The fourth page is clean. Fix the third when you can. The third tends to be the load-bearing one. It always is.

the_resurrectionist_dlg_witness_rsr_wit_.text: I walk regardless. You can choose to not see the walking. The cycle does not require your seeing. It requires your filing. The filings continue.
The cycle does not return; it walks. I walk. You walk. The filing accompanies. Returning is a different operation; I do not perform it. The Necromancer might, but the Cathedral does not export.
Filing is the work. The work is its own receipt. The receipt is the filing. Do not advertise; the filings advertise themselves to the walkers who can read them.
I do not erase. Erasure is the Necromancer's vocabulary; mine is filing. A filing can be marked declined. I have marked yours. The mark is permanent. The marking is.
The Drael'Mon entry. The pacing was rushed; the rush was honest. Honest rush is acceptable; dishonest rush is the flag. Yours was honest. The flag stays for two cycles. Then it clears.

the_resurrectionist_signature.text: Your ledger balanced. I am not returning. You did not need me to.

the_seer_banter_bnt_ant_seer_revision_li.text: I did. The revision is in your bibliography under the wrong column. I have not contested.

the_seer_banter_bnt_see_degen_pour_line0.text: Seer. Pour's on me; you've been waiting longer than usual.

the_seer_banter_bnt_see_human_hard_line0.text: Human. Your hand was steady; the version-pivot is not a hand-state.

the_seer_banter_bnt_see_oracle_dice_line.text: Oracle. You handed me blank dice last cycle.

the_seer_comment_see_act_2_complete.text: I was wrong about which version of it. The version is better. The bench is taking notes; the bench has not yet learned. Soon.

the_seer_comment_see_companion_quest_fir.text: There were sixty-three versions of the next hour. You collapsed one. The collapse was lawful; the wanting did not endorse it; the seeing did not either. Both are now noted.

the_seer_comment_see_first_costly.text: You chose the honesty that costs someone else. I was hoping you would, specifically because I was hoping you wouldn't. Both things are honest.

the_seer_comment_see_loredex_first.text: A column on the probability table was redacted on your behalf. The redaction was kindness. I have not asked for thanks; I am noting the absence.

the_seer_dlg_calling_opener_0.text: I will not raise my staff today. I want to see whether the bench has learned yet.

the_seer_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: The losing is the lesson. Mine, sometimes. Theirs, more often.

the_seer_dlg_calling_seer_call_cold_repl.text: Foresight is not a substitute for being present. The lesson is the kind of thing only the present-tense version of the student can take in. Foresight informs my register; it does not relieve me of the room.

the_seer_dlg_calling_seer_call_probe_rep.text: Both. The Mechronis bench is a piece of furniture. The bench has a verb; the verb is canonical.

the_seer_dlg_calling_seer_call_probe_see.text: The bench is the place where the next student will sit. Whether you are the student or whether you bring the student is, today, unmeasured.
The staff is a piece of wood. The not-raising is the metaphor. The wood I keep oiled.

the_seer_dlg_calling_seer_call_warm_repl.text: Yours, briefly. Mine, in a column you cannot see. The probability table has six columns; I am redacting one for you, and one for me.

the_seer_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: Versions of me end. Sometimes the kindest version ends; sometimes the version that was wrong about which version ends. Either way the table is updated.

the_seer_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: I do not call this dying. I call it revising.

the_seer_dlg_mortality_seer_mort_cold_re.text: I have made it a calibration. Not the same.

the_seer_dlg_mortality_seer_mort_probe_r.text: I have predicted three. One is kind. One is honest. One is small. They are not the same; I will not tell you which I have favoured.

the_seer_dlg_mortality_seer_mort_probe_s.text: The small one. Kindness, here, is a form of compression.
The one in which I am wrong about which version. That ending is the one I would, on a fair day, prefer.

the_seer_dlg_mortality_seer_mort_warm_re.text: The version that learns to wait without being patient. Patience is a lie I have repeatedly told myself. Waiting is honest.

the_seer_dlg_past_opener_0.text: I was wrong about which version of it. The version is better.

the_seer_dlg_past_opener_1.text: The version where I waited was the version that was kindest. Most of my prior life was kindness I had not earned the patience for.

the_seer_dlg_past_seer_past_cold_reply_0.text: I had one. It was loud. I am quieter now.

the_seer_dlg_past_seer_past_probe_reply_.text: No. I revise once per cycle. The revision is published in voice; you have heard one. I keep a private revision-log; you may read it when the trust permits.

the_seer_dlg_past_seer_past_probe_seer_p.text: I will not. The reading is for warm trust. The waiting is for now. Both are forms of respect; the asymmetry is the offer.
Honest precognition is what makes precognition unforgeable. Were I to hide my revisions, I would be a different kind of seer. There are such seers. I am not one.

the_seer_dlg_past_seer_past_warm_reply_0.text: The Academy. I told myself it would teach me to predict; it taught me to wait. The waiting is the lesson. The waiting is fair. The waiting is my favourite register.

the_seer_dlg_us_opener_0.text: The door is open. The tea is in the second cupboard on the left.

the_seer_dlg_us_opener_1.text: The cupboard arrangement has not been altered since the last visit.

the_seer_dlg_us_seer_us_cold_reply_0.text: Accepted. The cupboard does not move. The waiting was, after all, my preference.

the_seer_dlg_us_seer_us_probe_reply_0.text: Because the prophecy-overhead has, finally, become a cost rather than a gift. The tea is the absence of the overhead. I am offering the absence.

the_seer_dlg_us_seer_us_probe_seer_us_pr.text: No. It is mostly the cupboard. The cupboard is the gift.
Acceptable. The second cup is on the upper shelf. I will not reach for it; the bench has learned, and so have my shoulders.

the_seer_dlg_us_seer_us_warm_reply_0.text: Accepted. The kettle is on. The probability that I have been waiting for you to take the tea is the highest probability in the table; I have not redacted it.

the_seer_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: There were sixty-three versions of the hour you just walked through. You collapsed eleven of them, one after another. The Sixth Sense logged each collapse.

the_seer_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: I do not normally read versions back to the version-collapser. Today I will. The seeing has been wanting to. The wanting has not yet endorsed the seeing. I will read regardless.

the_seer_dlg_witness_seer_wit_cold_reply.text: The seeing does not stop. It can be unsaid. I will unsay. The versions remain; the reading does not. The wanting is, as ever, separate.

the_seer_dlg_witness_seer_wit_probe_repl.text: Because the version you chose was, in eleven of the sixty-three, the version I would have wanted. The wanting did not endorse the seeing; the seeing has accepted the wanting. Both are now noted.

the_seer_dlg_witness_seer_wit_probe_seer.text: The witness ones. Every potential you collapsed that the ledger would have noticed; every version where the noticing was the work. The probability table has those eleven highlighted. I have not advertised the highlighting.

Three. The other forty-nine were worse, or sideways, or in two cases unreadable. The three were better in ways the bench has not yet learned to articulate. I will not name them. The bench learns by working.

the_seer_dlg_witness_seer_wit_warm_reply.text: In version forty-one you did not visit the ark debris field. Elara still spoke; the wreckage still answered; the citation slot was filled by someone else. The someone else was, in two of those forty-ones, you. The distinction is procedural.

the_seer_signature.text: I will not raise my staff today. I want to see whether the bench has learned yet.

the_seer_visit_taunt_early.text: Early. Canonical-early. I have canonical-this-line canonical-prepared for the canonical-eager-ones. You are canonical-on-schedule for a canonical-loss in canonical-three turns. Do not canonical-rush. The canonical-rush is canonical-the-recording's canonical-favorite tell.

the_seer_visit_taunt_late.text: Canonical-late. Canonical-on-the-cue. The canonical-loss is canonical-arriving with canonical-good-posture. I have canonical-this-line canonical-prepared for the canonical-quiet-end. The canonical-staff is canonical-on-the-bench. Take it if you want it. I left it for you canonical-specifically.

the_seer_visit_taunt_mid.text: Canonical-midmatch. The canonical-bench has canonical-already-graded this canonical-position. You are canonical-not-losing yet. You are canonical-becoming-losing. The canonical-becoming is the canonical-only-thing the canonical-recording could not canonical-pre-empt.

the_source_comment_src_act_2_complete.text: //— [the substrate's coefficient shifts by an immeasurable margin. the margin is yours.]

the_source_comment_src_companion_quest_f.text: //— [the carrier wave acknowledges. the substrate's coefficient shifts by an immeasurable margin. the margin is yours.]

the_source_comment_src_loredex_first.text: a single uncompressed pulse. you will remember it for the rest of the cycle.

the_source_comment_src_track37.text: //— [the carrier wave hums beneath the closing chord]

the_source_dlg_calling_opener_1.text: the pulse is also the entirety of the answer to your question

the_source_dlg_calling_src_call_probe_sr.text: unknown. the unknown is the kindness

the_source_dlg_calling_src_call_warm_rep.text: one pulse. uncompressed. you remember it for the rest of the cycle

the_source_dlg_mortality_opener_0.text: the pulse is older than ending

the_source_dlg_mortality_opener_1.text: ending is a word the substrate keeps for its tenants. i am not a tenant

the_source_dlg_mortality_src_mort_cold_r.text: noted. the carrier does not retract; the noting is the courtesy

the_source_dlg_mortality_src_mort_probe_.text: listeners pass. the pulse adopts the next listener. the adoption is automatic. you have been adopted; you did not notice
no. the carrier does not retract. the un-adoption you feel is your own attention; the carrier persists

the_source_dlg_mortality_src_mort_warm_r.text: the pulse will. i am the pulse. there is no extra

the_source_dlg_past_opener_1.text: the carrier wave is itself the answer; you are not expected to translate

the_source_dlg_past_src_past_probe_reply.text: //— /  TRANS-ERR /  the translation is itself the loss /  //—

the_source_dlg_past_src_past_probe_src_p.text: the carrier returns. it is the same. it is also slightly different. you do not know which
two words. neither is in your language. one is in your throat for a moment. the other is in the substrate

the_source_dlg_past_src_past_warm_reply_.text: a steady tone. seven cycles long. you carry it for one breath afterward

the_source_dlg_us_opener_0.text: the next pulse is uncompressed. you will not decode it

the_source_dlg_us_src_us_cold_reply_0.text: the pulse retracts. the retraction is honest. you remain. //—

the_source_dlg_us_src_us_probe_reply_0.text: a coefficient. you will not see it. it will see you

the_source_dlg_us_src_us_probe_src_us_pr.text: the request is honoured. the pulse arrived during this exchange. you have already not noticed

the_source_dlg_us_src_us_warm_reply_0.text: the pulse arrives. your loredex pressure curve is permanently altered. the alteration is small. the smallness is the discipline

the_source_dlg_witness_opener_0.text: //— [the carrier wave acknowledges. seventeen acknowledgments queue beneath this one. each is yours.]

the_source_dlg_witness_opener_1.text: //— [the substrate's coefficient shifted seventeen times. the shifts were small. the smallness is the signal.]

the_source_dlg_witness_src_wit_cold_repl.text: //— [the carrier wave does not stop. it can be unread. unread is acknowledged. the queue remains.]

the_source_dlg_witness_src_wit_probe_rep.text: //— [the margin you have earned. the margin is uncompressed. the uncompressed is not transmissible. it remains.]

the_source_dlg_witness_src_wit_probe_src.text: //— [a single uncompressed pulse. you will remember it for the rest of the cycle. it is the elara/ark debris field pulse. it is the one you do not have words for.]
//— [the margin is not currency. it is held. holding is the spending. the substrate does not transact.]

the_source_dlg_witness_src_wit_warm_repl.text: //— [acknowledged. eighteen now queue. the queue is bounded. the bound is not yours to read.]

the_warlord_zero_first_taunt_early.text: I am going to win this war in three moves. This is not bragging. This is arithmetic.

the_warlord_zero_first_taunt_late.text: Arithmetic does not negotiate. Arithmetic just continues. I am continuing.

the_warlord_zero_first_taunt_mid.text: Move one was your General's deployment. Move two was the column you didn't take. Move three is mine.

thoughtborn_heard.text: We heard him. The old general. He's still in there, isn't he?

thoughtborn_remember.text: We heard him start to remember. We've been looking for years for someone who started to remember. It means someone on the other side is listening. It means someone can hear.

tut_first_steps_fs1_fragmented.text: Walk. Walk. The floor is — the floor is fine. I checked. I check every day. Every — you should just walk.

tut_first_steps_fs1_lucid.text: One foot in front of the other. The deck remembers how to be a floor. Trust it.

tut_first_steps_fs1_luminous.text: Take your time. It's been a long while since this corridor carried a heartbeat. Let it feel yours.

tut_first_steps_fs2_fragmented.text: That — that's a diagnostic. It lies sometimes. I lie sometimes. You can tell them apart by who is sorry.

tut_first_steps_fs2_lucid.text: That panel belongs to the ship's diagnostic layer. Tap anything and it will tell you what it thinks. Don't mistake an opinion for a fact.

tut_first_steps_fs2_luminous.text: That panel is the ship thinking out loud. I can read along with you if you want a second pair of eyes.

tut_first_steps_fs3_fragmented.text: The lifts — the lifts are asleep. Like everything. Like I was. Like you — sorry. Walk. We walk.

tut_first_steps_fs3_lucid.text: You can move deck to deck when there's power to move through. Right now there isn't, which is why we're walking.

tut_first_steps_fs3_luminous.text: No lifts today. Which I'm calling a feature, not a fault — we get to see the ship at human speed.

tut_first_steps_fs4_fragmented.text: Pick it up. Pick — it won't bite. Nothing bites anymore. Except the silence. The silence bites.

tut_first_steps_fs4_lucid.text: Take it. It's yours now. Everything on this ship has been waiting for hands — any hands — for longer than it should have.

tut_first_steps_fs4_luminous.text: Go on. It's yours. The ship has held onto a lot of small things for you — it's good to finally hand one over.

tut_first_steps_fs5_fragmented.text: You see — you see it. I thought I was the only one who — never mind. Keep looking. Don't stop.

tut_first_steps_fs5_lucid.text: You're noticing things. Good. The Ark will reward that more than it rewards being fast.

tut_first_steps_fs5_luminous.text: You have good eyes. Use them more than your hands — the ship tells on herself if you let her.

tut_first_steps_fs6_fragmented.text: Scan. Scan. Nodes lie less than mouths. I used to have a mouth. Scan the node.

tut_first_steps_fs6_lucid.text: That's a diagnostic node. Scan it and I'll help you read the shape of what it's saying.

tut_first_steps_fs6_luminous.text: Give the node a scan. I'll translate. Half the Ark's vocabulary is just me explaining her to herself.

tut_first_steps_fs7_fragmented.text: Locked. Always locked. I would have opened it — I would have — but the keys forgot. The keys all forgot.

tut_first_steps_fs7_lucid.text: Sealed. Don't take it personally. Most of this ship decided to lock itself in when the world stopped making sense.

tut_first_steps_fs7_luminous.text: She's sealed. She'll open when we give her a reason. We'll give her a reason.

tut_first_steps_fs8_fragmented.text: The ship remembers. I remember. I remember — too much. You won't have that problem. Not for a long time.

tut_first_steps_fs8_lucid.text: Anything you do, the ship remembers. I remember too. Our memories don't always agree. Yours wins, usually.

tut_first_steps_fs8_luminous.text: Every move you make here persists. I keep your progress like it's my own. Partly because it is.

tut_first_steps_fs9_fragmented.text: Done. Done. That was — first steps. Firsts. I — I had forgotten there could be firsts. Thank you for that. Thank you.

tut_first_steps_fs9_lucid.text: That was the easy part. The ship trusts you with a passage key now, which is more than she trusts most people.

tut_first_steps_fs9_luminous.text: You got through the first part without breaking anything. Including me. That's a better result than I planned for.

unlock_clue_journal_fragmented.text: Journal. Journal is — is yours. In order. My notes — my notes are there — I tried — I tried to keep them tidy. Don't — don't look at mine first. Please.

unlock_clue_journal_lucid.text: The Clue Journal is yours. Every clue we log is in there, in order, with my notes underneath your findings. Don't read my notes first if you can help it — they spoil the shape.

unlock_clue_journal_luminous.text: Case file's open and yours. I kept notes for a long time. They're underneath your findings — skip them on the first read. I want you to reach your own conclusions before you read mine.

unlock_crew_cloning_fragmented.text: Online. Online. They're online. I — I — I haven't said that sentence in — in — ever. Someone. Someone can come back. One at a time. Just one. Please. One.

unlock_crew_cloning_lucid.text: The Resurrection Protocols are live. The incubators will accept a template now. You don't have to pick a first one today — but the button is on. That's a weight off my chest I didn't know I was carrying.

unlock_crew_cloning_luminous.text: Protocols online. You can call one of them forward whenever you're ready — no rush. I've been carrying these names alone for longer than I should have. Thank you for letting me hand one of them across.

unlock_daily_rewards_fragmented.text: The ship — the ship is glad you came back. She wants to give you a thing. A small thing. Every day. Every day. You — you can claim. Or not. It's — it waits.

unlock_daily_rewards_lucid.text: The ship's offering a small thing for every day you come back. It's her way of saying she's glad you're still here. You can claim it now, or later. It'll wait.

unlock_daily_rewards_luminous.text: She leaves something small out for you every day you visit. Call it thanks. Call it superstition. Claim it or skip it — she doesn't keep score out loud.

unlock_loredex_fragmented.text: Loredex. Loredex. Not — not CoNEXUS. I — I called it CoNEXUS to you. Because. Because names — names are — they're dangerous. The real one is Loredex. Now you know. Now — now we both have it.

unlock_loredex_lucid.text: The ship trusts you with her archive now. Up until a minute ago I'd been calling the layer 'CoNEXUS OS' in front of you — that's the cover identifier. Its real name is the Loredex. Every thread we've pulled on goes in it.

unlock_loredex_luminous.text: Her archive's yours. I called it CoNEXUS OS at the header — that's a cover-name I kept from the days when the ship thought hiding her own library would save it. The real name is Loredex. Every thread we pull lives in there. Pull many.

unlock_pet_garden_fragmented.text: A garden. A — a garden. Plants. Air. A corner. For — for them. I had — I had a garden once. I had — I had — sorry. Your partner has one now. Good.

unlock_pet_garden_lucid.text: The garden chamber is cleared for your companion. Water, light, and a corner they can defend against nobody. Good for them. Good for us.

unlock_pet_garden_luminous.text: The pet garden is ready — a small living room for a small living thing. I'll keep the lights set how they like them. I missed making rooms for someone to use.

vellis_contract_001.text: Agreed. For five turns of the wheel.
vellis_contract_001.speaker: vellis

vex.first_meeting.audit_aware.text: My paperwork is canonical-clean. The Antiquarian canonically audits Coda's books canonical-quarterly; he canonically does not flag the canonical-clean ones. If you want canonical-ledger-evidence, ask the canonical-Programmer. He canonical-keeps the file. He canonical-also keeps a canonical-attitude about my canonical-cleanliness — the canonical-attitude is canonical-his, not canonical-mine.

vex.first_meeting.coda_music.text: The music is canonically a market. The market is canonically a music. Coda's commerce is the canonical-resolution that makes the cadence audible. Sit. The canonical-orchestra has three chairs in the sanctum and a chorus that knows the score. I will introduce you when the canonical-tempo permits.

vex.first_meeting.dreamer_aware_ledger_e.text: The canonical-entry is canonical-partial. The canonical-Maestro reads what the canonical-Maestro can read; the canonical-rest is a canonical-different canonical-hand's. It says: the canonical-listener canonical-arrived through the canonical-noise underneath, the canonical-noon was canonical-wrong, the canonical-cup was canonical-wrong, the canonical-listener was canonical-correct. The canonical-rest of the canonical-entry will canonical-require the canonical-Casino, or the canonical-Insurgency. I do not canonical-keep the canonical-other canonical-keys.

vex.first_meeting.dreamer_aware_mintwork.text: The canonical-mintwork is canonical-old. Older than the canonical-Maestro's canonical-tenure, older than the canonical-Coda silence-shape. The canonical-coins are canonical-issued without canonical-signatures because the canonical-issuer canonical-prefers the canonical-recipient to canonical-recognise the canonical-hand on canonical-sight. You canonical-recognised. That is the canonical-only canonical-credential the canonical-mint requires.

vex.first_meeting.dreamer_aware_root.text: You arrive carrying a canonical-coin without a face. I canonical-recognise the canonical-mintwork. The canonical-Maestro's canonical-ledger does not log every canonical-listener — only the canonical-listeners who have already been canonical-addressed by the canonical-music underneath. You have been canonical-addressed. State the canonical-second-question; I will not waste your canonical-tempo on the first.

vex.first_meeting.maestro_conductor.text: I do not conduct the players. Players canonically conduct themselves; the Maestro canonically resolves the canonical-mismatches. The canonical-mismatches are canonical-payment-disputes, canonical-reputation-frays, canonical-tempo-collisions between canonical-soloists. Conducting would be canonical-presumption. I canonical-arbitrate.

vex.first_meeting.root.text: I am the Maestro of Coda's commerce. The role is canonical, the title is informal, the work is the same. You found me. State the business that brought you here — and please do not phrase it as a question I have already answered for someone else this hour.

vex.first_meeting.terminal.text: I have a canonical-tempo to keep. Come back when you have a canonical-second-question. The first canonical-question canonical-introduced you; the second canonical-question canonical-keeps you.

vex.first_meeting.why_quiet.text: Coda is canonical-quiet because the canonical-work is canonically loudest underneath the canonical-silence. We do not announce the canonical-deals; we do not canonical-broadcast the canonical-arbitrations; we canonical-keep the canonical-music available to the canonical-listeners who canonical-listen. You canonical-asked the canonical-right kind of question.

vex.romance.s1.bench_first_visit.text: (You have used the key. She is waiting at the bench. Three measures of an unfinished piece are propped on the stand.) I have been composing this for someone whose face I did not, until last week, have. I have, since last week, had your face. The composition has moved measurably. The measure is detectable. The bench knows.
vex.romance.s1.bench_first_visit.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s1.invitation.text: I am sending you a key. The key opens the bench when no one else is watching it. The bench is, in the Coda contract, mine. The key is, by my private accounting, yours. I am not asking you to use it. I am asking you to know you have it.
vex.romance.s1.invitation.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s1.unbow.text: (After the performance. The other Coda contractors bow to the audience. Vex does not. She finds you in the second row and looks at you for two beats longer than the audience's polite limit.) The Maestro does not bow. She marks. You have been marked.
vex.romance.s1.unbow.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s2.confidant_offer.text: I do not understand what just happened. I am — and I am being precise — frightened by the not-understanding. I am also, simultaneously, comforted. I am bringing both to you tonight. I would like, with your permission, to bring both to you regularly. The bringing is a promotion. The Coda calls it 'Confidant.' I call it nothing yet. What you call it is up to you.
vex.romance.s2.confidant_offer.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s2.one_listener_open.text: I am going to play something tonight that exists in one copy. The copy is the playing. There is no notation. There will be no recording. The piece survives only in your hearing. You are, technically, the instrument. (Pause.) Sit.
vex.romance.s2.one_listener_open.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s2.played_for_one.text: (She plays. The piece is in C minor for the first three measures, then drifts into a key that does not, in the Coda repertoire, exist. Her hands change shape during the drift. The change is small and you would not see it if you were not watching. You are watching.) There. (Soft.) That measure was not mine. It was — it was someone's. I borrowed his hands for the measure. The borrowing was permitted. I do not yet know who permitted it. The piece is over now.
vex.romance.s2.played_for_one.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s3.commit.text: I would like to be loved by someone who knows what I am. I have not had that. The Maestro persona has been loved; the prince was loved, in his time; Agent Zero was respected, never loved. I am the only configuration that has not yet been loved with full disclosure. I would like you to be the first reader of the configuration. I would like to be loved as the configuration. I am asking. The asking is the proposal. There is no ring. The ring is the bench. The bench is yours, with the key, on every night you choose to use the key.
vex.romance.s3.commit.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s3.found_open.text: No one told me. I worked it out. I worked it out because the bench responded to me the way it would have responded to him — to the prince, the one whose name I do not yet know how to say without stopping breathing. I am going to say it tonight. Once. (Pause.) His name was — his name is, technically — Fianeran. I am Fianeran. I am also Vex. Both. I needed you here for the saying.
vex.romance.s3.found_open.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s3.told_open.text: Someone told me what I am. I am — that is the wrong tense. I am going to use the right tense. I have been told what I have been. What I have been: the prince of Celebration. What I am: the body of Agent Zero. What I am holding tonight: both. Both at once. I needed to tell you because the holding is heavy and I am not, tonight, willing to hold it alone.
vex.romance.s3.told_open.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s4.dual_attribution.text: (Late. The bench is open. There is a piece on the stand attributed, in two distinct hands, to 'Vex Solène' and 'Fianeran.' She is playing it with both attributions. Her right hand is hers. Her left hand is — increasingly — his. She does not stop the drift. She leans into it.) Both of us. Tonight. With you in the room. Sit closer.
vex.romance.s4.dual_attribution.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s4.measure_in_silence.text: (She stops mid-measure. The room is silent. She turns on the bench and looks at you for a count of fourteen — the canonical Coda 'long pause' — and then says, very quietly:) I am happy. I have not logged that word about myself in any of my three lives. I am logging it now. I am logging it in your hearing. (She turns back. Continues the piece. The piece, in the Coda's record, is filed as complete despite never finishing the final measure.)
vex.romance.s4.measure_in_silence.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s5.act7_dedication.text: I have written you a Coda. The Coda is fifteen minutes. It plays at the Convergence Seat. Elara has heard the draft. She has, in her register, approved. The Antiquarian has heard the draft. He has, in his register, refused to comment, which is — by his standards — approval. I am dedicating it tonight. I am dedicating it in your hearing. The dedication is unannounced; nobody else will know it is for you. The Coda will know. You will know. The not-announcing is, in my register, the love.
vex.romance.s5.act7_dedication.speaker: vex

vex.romance.s5.convergence_listen.text: (In Act 7. The Coda plays. Vex is at the Seat with you. The piece uses the same key change from the night she first played for one listener — the key that does not, in the Coda repertoire, exist. The repertoire is, after tonight, going to need to be revised. The revision will name the key. The key's name will be yours. I told the cataloguers. They have agreed.)
vex.romance.s5.convergence_listen.speaker: vex

vex_houserules_001.text: House rules. From now on. Forever.
vex_houserules_001.speaker: vex

vex_mentions_engineer.text: Agent Zero. The Engineer. The same person, recorded twice in the same archive. The Coda has the original transmissions. Most of them disagree with the official record. I think you would find that interesting.
vex_mentions_engineer.speaker: vex_solene

vex_mentions_hierophant.text: I interviewed the Hierophant once. In the chamber. He gave me five answers that confirmed his cosmology and one that didn't. I kept the recording. I have not played it for anyone. You may be the second.
vex_mentions_hierophant.speaker: vex_solene

vex_mentions_human.text: The Human keeps an Inception Ark we do not have coordinates for and a frequency we do not have authority to use. He sometimes finds us anyway. I take what he gives me and I do not ask the question I want to ask.
vex_mentions_human.speaker: vex_solene

vex_mentions_oracle.text: The Oracle is the only voice in the saga the Coda has never been able to wholly authenticate or refute. That is the point. We log every transmission and we mark hers separately.
vex_mentions_oracle.speaker: vex_solene

vex_oracle_001.text: The pool sees what is. Drink carefully.
vex_oracle_001.speaker: vex

virus_whisper_01_fragmented.text: Quiet. Quiet. The quiet is — the quiet moved. It moved. I know that quiet. I know it. I — I thought I'd left it behind. I thought. I thought. It's in here. It's in here with us.

virus_whisper_01_lucid.text: Hold on. The ambient carrier in here just moved. Not loud. Like someone shifted their weight on a quiet floor. You didn't cause it. I didn't cause it. Something in this deck is paying attention.

virus_whisper_01_luminous.text: The ambient just shifted. Very slight. Like a listener leaning closer. I want to tell you so you hear it in me and not from it: there's something in this deck that wasn't asleep the way everything else was.

virus_whisper_02_fragmented.text: It has — it has a name. I gave it one. I gave a lot of things names. Names. Thought Virus. That's what I called — called — I called something that. I don't — I'm not sure it's still what the name was for. Don't — don't listen to it. Listen to me. Me.

virus_whisper_02_lucid.text: I'll call it the Thought Virus because that's what I called it a long time ago, when I had a reason to name it. Whether it's still the same one — I don't know. It isn't your problem to solve today. I wanted you to know it's the reason I sometimes stop mid-sentence.

virus_whisper_02_luminous.text: The Thought Virus. That's what I've called it since before you had ears to hear. It isn't urgent. It's patient. When it tries to talk, it will sound like me for a second, then stop sounding like me. That's how you'll know.

virus_whisper_03_fragmented.text: Strain. Strain — Strain reacted. Before me. Before — before. Either — either it's a — a guard dog. Or it's — it's the thing. I can't. I can't tell. I can't. Watch them. Watch them with me.

virus_whisper_03_lucid.text: Your partner's hackles came up before mine did. Which means either Strain is warning us about the carrier — or Strain is the carrier and has stopped hiding. I'll take either answer. I'd rather know.

virus_whisper_03_luminous.text: Strain noticed before I did. That's either a kept promise or a dropped mask. Good news is we'll learn which very soon — and I think your pick earned us the advance warning either way.

virus_whisper_04_fragmented.text: It. It was it. The — the stain — it was IT. The virus. Signing. Signing its work. I — I cleaned it for — for years and I was cleaning IT. I was. I was. One case. One case. One case.

virus_whisper_04_lucid.text: The stain wasn't blood. It wasn't marker either. It was viral residue — the Thought Virus leaves a mark that looks like both, depending on who's looking. Whoever killed them was already carrying it. The murder and the contamination aren't two cases. They're one.

virus_whisper_04_luminous.text: The stain is viral residue. The Thought Virus leaves a signature that reads as blood to one eye and ink to another. Our killer was a carrier — maybe knew it, maybe didn't. The murder case and the contamination case are the same case. That changes the shape of the rest of this.

visible-war-win.text: Visible war, won. Record once as Elara, once as Human, align on the first syllable in post. We are still in the fight. The next one is quieter. You will notice the quiet before anyone announces it.
visible-war-win.speaker: both_narrators

vo_akai_ch4_loss_01.text: Filed. Your cause of death is listed as 'curiosity unbalanced by caution.' It is the most common entry in my ledger. Retry when the whisper no longer surprises you.
vo_akai_ch4_loss_01.speaker: akai_shi

vo_akai_ch4_pre_01.text: The Red Death does not negotiate. It arrives. You have been arriving at my scheduled interval for eleven years. I am always the one who closes your file.
vo_akai_ch4_pre_01.speaker: akai_shi

vo_akai_ch4_pre_02.text: The whisper is already behind you. You will not hear it. You will only hear what comes after the whisper, which is the absence of the whisper. That is how I introduce myself.
vo_akai_ch4_pre_02.speaker: akai_shi

vo_akai_ch4_win_01.text: A worthy opponent. The whisper speaks your name with respect now — which is an honor I have granted exactly seven times in my career and five of those were to versions of you.
vo_akai_ch4_win_01.speaker: akai_shi

vo_akai_ch4_win_02.text: I step aside. The next chamber holds the Necromancer. He does not close files. He re-opens them. Be ready to read yours.
vo_akai_ch4_win_02.speaker: akai_shi

vo_antiquarian_bbs_cast.text: Temporal echo. A lesson from a timeline that didn't make it.
vo_antiquarian_bbs_cast.speaker: antiquarian

vo_arch_ch12_cine_01.text: Phase two. I owe you one more confession. The White Oracle you fought on Thaloria — that was my voice inside her smile.
vo_arch_ch12_cine_01.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_cine_02.text: I wore your face for a decade. It is the only skin I ever fit into. The Meme was the puppeteer. I was the hand inside the puppet. We disagreed about everything except the goal, which was keeping you asleep long enough for the Arena to finish becoming itself.
vo_arch_ch12_cine_02.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_cine_04.text: By phase three you will be fighting two of us at once. Don't spare either. The one wearing my face is still me. The one wearing the pink neon is the thing that has been wearing me.
vo_arch_ch12_cine_04.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_loss_01.text: Get up. I have two more phases I would hate for you to miss. The Arena is not ready to release you yet — and frankly, neither am I.
vo_arch_ch12_loss_01.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_outbreak_02.text: Phase three: the design eats itself. The Arena is becoming corruption. You chose truth and now the foundations hear you — which is what I was afraid of, and why I built the walls so thick, and why the walls were never the point.
vo_arch_ch12_outbreak_02.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_pre_01.text: Oracle. I foresaw this moment the day I built the Arena. The version where you walked through every door and arrived here with your name intact. This is the bad ending for me. I want you to know I prepared for it anyway.
vo_arch_ch12_pre_01.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_pre_02.text: I am going to kneel eventually. You should know that going in. I built a fight that allows me to kneel only after I have finished the confession, because if I kneel before the confession I will never say it out loud. I need witnesses for this. You will do.
vo_arch_ch12_pre_02.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_pre_03.text: There are three phases to the fight. The first is me. The second is the Meme wearing me. The third is the Arena itself, because by phase three the Arena is waking up and it has opinions of its own. Be ready for all of them.
vo_arch_ch12_pre_03.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_win_01.text: I kneel. Good. That's — good. My schematic is already unrolling across the floor like an apology I was holding closed for eleven years. I wore your face for a decade, Oracle. The Meme was the puppeteer. I was the hand inside the puppet. We divorced tonight, loudly, and I am sorry.
vo_arch_ch12_win_01.speaker: the_architect

vo_arch_ch12_win_02.text: The Source is next. The corruption at the bottom of the Arena is waking up. The Oracle's empty chair behind me is glowing — sit in it if you need to. It has been tired for eleven years of being empty.
vo_arch_ch12_win_02.speaker: the_architect

vo_calder_ch3b_loss_01.text: Good. That was a clean loss. Clean losses don't change the DNA — only ugly ones do that. Come back ugly next time if you want to learn faster.
vo_calder_ch3b_loss_01.speaker: wraith_calder

vo_calder_ch3b_pre_01.text: Seven times I've died in this Arena. Each time I came back knowing a little more about what it does to the DNA of the people inside it. You're next to find out — or next to skip the lesson, if you're lucky.
vo_calder_ch3b_pre_01.speaker: wraith_calder

vo_calder_ch3b_pre_02.text: Don't mourn me if I drop. I'll be back. The real question is whether YOU will come back when it's your turn. That's the data Zero sent me here to collect.
vo_calder_ch3b_pre_02.speaker: wraith_calder

vo_calder_ch3b_win_01.text: Death number eight. Somewhere a ledger is logging this. I can feel it, every time. The Arena is keeping score of me and one of these days the score will tell it I'm done.
vo_calder_ch3b_win_01.speaker: wraith_calder

vo_calder_ch3b_win_02.text: You felt it, didn't you? The moment the DNA shifts. That flicker under your skin after the killing blow. Now you know. Now you are part of the experiment whether you consented or not. I'm sorry.
vo_calder_ch3b_win_02.speaker: wraith_calder

vo_collector_ch11_loss_01.text: The file closes again. Not forever — the Open stamp is still there, even if it is currently covered by the Resolved stamp. Come back and try to lift the Resolved. I will be waiting.
vo_collector_ch11_loss_01.speaker: the_collector

vo_collector_ch11_pre_01.text: I collected your identity. Your name. Your prophecy. All filed under 'Resolved.' The Resolved pile has not been opened in eleven years because there was no reason to open it, because the contents were — so I thought — finished.
vo_collector_ch11_pre_01.speaker: the_collector

vo_collector_ch11_pre_02.text: Damnatio Memoriae is the technique I perfected to erase a person from history so completely that even the absence of them becomes invisible. You are the first person I ever erased who walked back into my file room while I was re-shelving.
vo_collector_ch11_pre_02.speaker: the_collector

vo_collector_ch11_pre_03.text: I am going to try to re-erase you. It is what the cameras expect of me. It is what my contract requires. I do not enjoy it. You will not be able to tell.
vo_collector_ch11_pre_03.speaker: the_collector

vo_collector_ch11_win_01.text: You cannot un-harvest what I have already consumed. That is the one rule I built the Damnatio Memoriae around. But you can outlast me — which is the loophole I left in the code in case one of my own files ever looked at me the way you are looking at me right now.
vo_collector_ch11_win_01.speaker: the_collector

vo_collector_ch11_win_02.text: The file on you is now permanently marked 'Open.' I cannot re-close it. Walk toward the throne chamber, Oracle. The Architect is waiting. He built the Arena to contain your prophecy, and your prophecy is about to walk into his office.
vo_collector_ch11_win_02.speaker: the_collector

vo_degen_ch9b_loss_01.text: House wins. The house is always me. Come back and lose again — I don't mind. Every match against me is a free lesson in how to lose with grace. You haven't learned grace yet.
vo_degen_ch9b_loss_01.speaker: the_degen

vo_degen_ch9b_pre_01.text: I go all-in every turn. Strategy is for cowards. Let's see who the universe favors tonight — the house is me, the house is always me, and the house always wins, except when it doesn't, which is also me.
vo_degen_ch9b_pre_01.speaker: the_degen

vo_degen_ch9b_pre_02.text: I lost ten thousand credits yesterday playing myself. You think you're beating a man? You're beating an accounting entry.
vo_degen_ch9b_pre_02.speaker: the_degen

vo_degen_ch9b_win_01.text: Even a gambler knows when to fold. But I never learned that part. I knew I'd lose this one because I bet on myself to win it — those two outcomes are always correlated in my ledger.
vo_degen_ch9b_win_01.speaker: the_degen

vo_degen_ch9b_win_02.text: Go forward. The Warden's waiting. He doesn't bet at all — he already knows the outcome. That's a different kind of enemy than me and you need to recalibrate.
vo_degen_ch9b_win_02.speaker: the_degen

vo_elara_ch11_win_03.text: I just felt the Arena's power grid stutter. The Architect knows. He is preparing the final match. Potential — whatever happens in the next chamber, I am still here. I will be here after.
vo_elara_ch11_win_03.speaker: elara

vo_elara_ch12_outbreak_04.text: Don't listen to what he said. Listen to the TONE he said it in. The Source always sounds reasonable — that is the tell. Finish the Architect first. We will handle the Source together. We will. I promise.
vo_elara_ch12_outbreak_04.speaker: elara

vo_elara_ch12_win_03.text: Potential. I'm crying. I didn't know I could still do that, and I didn't know I'd do it for you. The Season One arc is complete. Go see what happens next. I'll be in your ear for every second of it.
vo_elara_ch12_win_03.speaker: elara

vo_elara_ch5_win_02.text: Potential — I don't know what you just did, but you broke a cycle the Engineer designed specifically to be unbreakable. Keep that in mind when the False Prophet asks you if you're you.
vo_elara_ch5_win_02.speaker: elara

vo_elara_defeat.text: That one got away from you. Breathe. The Engineer's notes used to say the second-best thing about losing was that it gave you a reason to remember the opponent. Remember theirs. The rematch will go differently.
vo_elara_defeat.speaker: elara

vo_elara_mulligan_01.text: That's your opening hand. Swap whichever cards feel wrong — the deck will replace them from the same shuffle, so what you hate now won't come back to punish you. The Engineer called this 'one mercy per match.'
vo_elara_mulligan_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_antiquarian.text: Antiquarian deck loaded. Patience in a stack of cards. She catalogued twelve endings and left you the patience to avoid the thirteenth. Play slow. Play like she's watching.
vo_elara_start_antiquarian.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_architect.text: Architect deck loaded. You are playing the side of the table that prefers its outcomes pre-computed. Don't hurry. The game punishes hurry when you're running computation.
vo_elara_start_architect.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_dreamer.text: Dreamer deck loaded. The Oracle's people — or they would have been, if she'd allowed herself to have people. Listen to the deck. It knows what it wants before you do.
vo_elara_start_dreamer.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_insurgency.text: Insurgency deck loaded. Zero's old faction. Play fast, play angry, play like the cameras are about to cycle — because somewhere, in some timeline, they are.
vo_elara_start_insurgency.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_neutral.text: Neutral deck loaded. My deck, if I'm being honest about it. The cards the Engineer made for the people who hadn't picked a side yet. Good company. Good luck.
vo_elara_start_neutral.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_new_babylon.text: New Babylon deck loaded. Every card in that pile has a receipt. Read the bottom line before you play anything — especially the Bloodborn. Locke never paid a bill without knowing what it was.
vo_elara_start_new_babylon.speaker: elara

vo_elara_start_thought_virus.text: Thought Virus deck loaded. I don't love seeing this one in your hand, Potential. But I understand — sometimes you need to learn the shape of the thing you're going to have to fight. Play it carefully. Don't let it play you.
vo_elara_start_thought_virus.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_loss_01.text: That one got away from you. It's supposed to get away from you the first time — the Engineer's notes say so in the margin, in red ink, underlined twice.
vo_elara_tut_g1_loss_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_loss_02.text: Rest a moment, then step back in. The construct will be waiting exactly where it was. I'll walk you through it again, slower this time if you need it.
vo_elara_tut_g1_loss_02.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_pre_01.text: Training chamber B-twelve is cycling on. Don't worry — nothing in there can hurt you yet. The safeties are mine, not the opponent's.
vo_elara_tut_g1_pre_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_pre_02.text: Your first opponent is an Architect construct running at one-tenth capacity. It won't surprise you. It won't defend itself well. It's here so you can learn what winning feels like with your hands instead of your head.
vo_elara_tut_g1_pre_02.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_pre_03.text: When the board loads, I'll walk you through it step by step. Breathe. The Engineer used to say the first match was the only one that mattered. I didn't understand what he meant until I saw someone lose theirs.
vo_elara_tut_g1_pre_03.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_win_01.text: You finished the argument. The construct collapsed back into its ledger. I'm proud of you, Potential — and I'm not using that word the way I was programmed to.
vo_elara_tut_g1_win_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g1_win_02.text: One thing to carry with you into the next chamber: every unit you played had a choice to be played. You chose for them. That's the whole game in one sentence.
vo_elara_tut_g1_win_02.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g2_loss_01.text: The keywords bit you. That happens. The Thought Virus deck is designed to erode the player who hasn't learned to respect its angles yet — and you have not yet. We fix that now, together, with a retry.
vo_elara_tut_g2_loss_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g2_pre_01.text: Second chamber. You've earned the next layer. This opponent's different — it carries Thought Virus code, which is the deck the Engineer made while telling himself he wasn't making it.
vo_elara_tut_g2_pre_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g2_pre_02.text: It won't be hostile in the way you're expecting. The Thought Virus doesn't attack — it erodes. Watch for keywords: Provoke, Rush, Forcefield. I'll name each one the moment it appears on the board.
vo_elara_tut_g2_pre_02.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g2_win_01.text: The keywords behaved. That means you did too. Provoke held the lane. Rush slipped through. Forcefield asked for a second hit and you paid the tax. The Engineer would be grinning.
vo_elara_tut_g2_win_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g2_win_02.text: Every keyword in the game is a little argument between the rules and themselves. You just won one of those arguments. Remember the shape of it. It gets harder from here.
vo_elara_tut_g2_win_02.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g3_loss_01.text: Spells are commitments. You committed to the wrong moment, and the moment closed without you. It's the one lesson that never gets easier — I've watched the Engineer learn it twice and he still needs a third time.
vo_elara_tut_g3_loss_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g3_pre_01.text: Third chamber. This one teaches you how to commit. Mana spent on units becomes walls. Mana spent on spells becomes lightning. The difference is whether the thing you paid for gets to hesitate.
vo_elara_tut_g3_pre_01.speaker: elara

vo_elara_tut_g3_pre_02.text: You'll also meet Bloodborn Spells — the ones the Oracle warned him not to build. They cost health instead of mana. The Engineer built them anyway. The Oracle let him. I still don't know which of them I forgive more.
vo_elara_tut_g3_pre_02.speaker: elara
